https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-stamme.body: The Ghana Stammering Association (GSA) has called for greater understanding and inclusion of people who stammer, urging Ghanaians to create spaces where everyone can communicate without fear of ridicule or discrimination. In a statement marking International Stammering Awareness Day 2026, the association said the varied experiences of people who stammer must be recognised rather than reduced to a single narrative. According to GSA, the theme highlights that stammering does not look or sound the same for everyone, and that some experiences may be less visible than others. “Some people may openly repeat sounds, words or phrases, stretch sounds, or get stuck when speaking — this is often described as overt stammering,” the statement explained. Others, it noted, may conceal their stammering by substituting words, avoiding particular situations, pretending not to know an answer or choosing to remain silent. These experiences are often described as covert stammering. The association said people also adopt different approaches to navigating their speech. While some use speech techniques, others focus on accepting their stammering, with many experiencing a combination of approaches. “These are all different shades of stammering, and every experience is valid,” GSA stated. The association said the observance offered an opportunity to acknowledge both the difficulties people who stammer face and the positive experiences that can emerge from their lives. It identified stigma, bullying, discrimination, communication barriers and pressure to speak fluently as challenges that people who stammer may encounter. At the same time, GSA noted that many develop greater self-awareness, resilience, empathy and advocacy skills, while building meaningful connections with others through their experiences. The association encouraged people who stammer to share their stories to deepen public understanding and demonstrate that there is no single way to stammer or to experience life as someone who stammers. “We encourage people who stammer to share their experiences and help others understand that there is no single way to stammer and no single way to experience life as a person who stammers,” it said. GSA also appealed to parents, teachers, employers, speech and language therapists, researchers, policymakers and the wider public to listen to people who stammer and consider how to make their environments more inclusive. The call places emphasis on enabling people to participate and express themselves without facing judgement about how they speak. As part of the observance, the association invited reflection on individual experiences, the lessons people have learnt and the collective action needed to improve inclusion. “What is your shade of stammering? What have you experienced? What have you learned? And what can we do together to create a more inclusive world for people who stammer?” the statement asked
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-stamme.title_zh: 加纳口吃协会呼吁包容并结束污名
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-stamme.body_zh: 加纳口吃协会（GSA）呼吁更多地理解和包容口吃者，敦促加纳人创造让每个人都能沟通而不必担心被嘲笑或歧视的空间。在纪念2026年国际口吃意识日的声明中，该协会表示，必须承认口吃者多样化的经历，而不是将其简化为单一叙事。据GSA称，这一主题强调口吃对每个人来说看起来或听起来并不相同，有些经历可能不如其他经历那么明显。“有些人可能会公开重复声音、单词或短语，拉长声音，或者在说话时卡住——这通常被称为显性口吃，”声明解释道。它指出，其他人可能会通过替换单词、避免特定情境、假装不知道答案或选择保持沉默来掩盖他们的口吃。这些经历通常被称为隐性口吃。该协会表示，人们还会采用不同的方法来应对他们的言语。有些人使用言语技巧，而其他人则专注于接受他们的口吃，许多人则经历这些方法的结合。“这些都是口吃的不同阴影，每一种经历都是有效的，”GSA表示。该协会称，这一纪念活动提供了一个机会，既承认口吃者面临的困难，也承认他们生活中可能出现的积极经历。它指出，污名、欺凌、歧视、沟通障碍以及流利说话的压力是口吃者可能遇到的挑战。同时，GSA指出，许多人通过他们的经历发展出更强的自我意识、韧性、同理心和倡导技能，同时与他人建立有意义的联系。该协会鼓励口吃者分享他们的故事，以加深公众理解，并证明口吃或作为口吃者体验生活没有单一的方式。“我们鼓励口吃者分享他们的经历，并帮助他人理解口吃没有单一的方式，作为口吃者体验生活也没有单一的方式，”它说。GSA还呼吁父母、教师、雇主、言语和语言治疗师、研究人员、决策者和更广泛的公众倾听口吃者的声音，并考虑如何使他们的环境更具包容性。这一呼吁强调让人们能够参与和表达自己，而不会因说话方式而面临评判。作为纪念活动的一部分，该协会邀请人们反思个人经历、人们学到的教训以及为改善包容性所需的集体行动。“你的口吃阴影是什么？你经历了什么？你学到了什么？我们能一起做什么来为口吃者创造一个更具包容性的世界？”声明问道

https://www.myjoyonline.com/akosua-manu-.summary: The Advisor on Gender and Social Protection to Dr Mahamudu Bawumia, Akosua Manu, has called on Vice President Prof. Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang to use her office and influence to ensure justice for students at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) following allegations of sexual abuse.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/akosua-manu-.summary_zh: 马哈穆杜·巴武米亚博士的性别与社会保护顾问阿科苏阿·马努呼吁副总统简·娜娜·奥普库-阿杰曼教授利用其职位和影响力，确保奥布阿西高级技术学校（SHTS）的学生获得正义，此前有性虐待指控。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/akosua-manu-.body: The Advisor on Gender and Social Protection to Dr Mahamudu Bawumia, Akosua Manu, has called on Vice President Prof. Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang to use her office and influence to ensure justice for students at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) following allegations of sexual abuse. She said the Vice President’s position as a woman in a historic leadership role carried significant meaning for Ghanaian girls; hence, it must produce tangible improvements in their safety and welfare. In an op-ed titled “A Party Card Is Not a Certificate of Immunity,” published on her social media platforms on Monday, October 19, 2026, Akosua Manu challenged the Vice President to translate her advocacy for girls into practical measures that protect them from abuse. “Your voice and influence must help secure an impartial response, even where it requires uncomfortable questions within your own political circles,” she said. She noted that the allegations at Obuasi SHTS raised broader concerns about the handling of sexual misconduct complaints in schools, particularly reports that earlier complaints had been made but apparently remained unresolved. “According to investigative reporting, students raised complaints, teachers expressed concerns, and petitions reached the relevant authorities. Each was an opportunity to establish the facts and protect the girls. Yet the complaints apparently remained unresolved,” she noted She said the circumstances demanded answers about what authorities knew, when they became aware of the complaints and what steps they took to protect the students. She urged the Vice President to ensure that the allegations were investigated without political interference, emphasising that political affiliation should neither determine how complaints are treated nor shield anyone from accountability. The gender advocate also called on the Minister for Gender, Children and Social Protection, Dr Agnes Naa Momo Lartey, to provide clear answers on the support being offered to the alleged victims and their families. She asked the Ministry to outline measures to prevent intimidation, protect the students’ privacy and education, and guarantee their access to justice. “Representation must translate into protection,” she stressed, arguing that the responsibility to safeguard children rested with the entire government, particularly institutions mandated to protect vulnerable people. Beyond the immediate case, Akosua Manu called for an independent review of how allegations of sexual misconduct were handled across schools, insisting that students needed confidential reporting channels outside the authority of the persons they accused. Akosua Manu commended investigative journalist Manasseh Azure Awuni and other journalists who brought the allegations to national attention, but warned that investigative journalism should not become a substitute for effective child-protection institutions. She concluded by advocating for the protection of victims against retaliation, prompt referral of suspected criminal offences to the appropriate investigative authorities and professional support for affected students
https://www.myjoyonline.com/akosua-manu-.title_zh: Akosua Manu呼吁副总统干预Obuasi SHTS虐待案
https://www.myjoyonline.com/akosua-manu-.body_zh: 马哈穆杜·鲍米亚博士的性别与社会保护顾问阿科苏阿·马努呼吁副总统简·娜娜·奥普库-阿吉曼教授利用其职位和影响力，确保奥布阿西高级技术学校（SHTS）的学生获得正义，此前有性虐待指控。她表示，副总统作为女性担任这一历史性领导职位，对加纳女孩具有重要意义；因此，它必须为她们的安全和福祉带来切实改善。在10月19日星期一发表于其社交媒体平台的题为《党证不是豁免证书》的专栏文章中，阿科苏阿·马努敦促副总统将她对女孩的倡导转化为保护她们免受虐待的实际措施。“您的声音和影响力必须帮助确保公正回应，即使这需要在您自己的政治圈内提出令人不舒服的问题，”她说。她指出，奥布阿西SHTS的指控引发了对学校处理性行为不端投诉的更广泛担忧，特别是此前有报告称曾提出投诉但显然仍未得到解决。“根据调查报道，学生提出投诉，教师表达担忧，请愿书送达相关当局。每一次都是查明事实和保护女孩的机会。然而这些投诉显然仍未得到解决，”她指出。她说，这种情况要求回答当局知道什么、何时获悉投诉以及他们采取了什么步骤来保护学生。她敦促副总统确保对这些指控进行调查而不受政治干预，并强调政治从属关系既不应决定如何处理投诉，也不应庇护任何人免于问责。这位性别倡导者还呼吁性别、儿童和社会保护部长阿格尼丝·娜·莫莫·拉泰博士就向 alleged 受害者及其家人提供的支持提供明确答复。她要求该部概述防止恐吓、保护学生隐私和教育以及保障她们获得正义的措施。“代表必须转化为保护，”她强调，认为保护儿童的责任在于整个政府，特别是那些被授权保护弱势群体的机构。除了当前案件外，阿科苏阿·马努呼吁对学校如何处理性行为不端指控进行独立审查，坚持认为学生需要独立于他们所指控对象权威之外的保密报告渠道。阿科苏阿·马努赞扬了调查记者马纳塞·阿祖尔·阿乌尼和其他将这些指控带到全国关注的记者，但警告说调查性新闻不应成为有效儿童保护机构的替代品。她最后主张保护受害者免受报复，及时将涉嫌刑事犯罪移交给适当的调查当局，并为受影响的学生提供专业支持

https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-agrif.summary: Stakeholders in the agriculture sector in Obuasi and two local municipal assemblies are forging ahead to transform the town from its known status as a gold mining community to a rich agricultural hub to feed the country. In collaboration with AngloGold Ashanti’s Obuasi Mine, the maiden Agrifair is organised to promote agribusiness, create employment opportunities for young people and strengthen agricultural production in the Adansi area and beyond.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-agrif.summary_zh: 奥布阿西农业部门的利益相关者和两个地方市政议会正在推进工作，将该镇从已知的黄金开采社区转变为一个丰富的农业中心，以养活整个国家。在与盎格鲁黄金阿散蒂公司奥布阿西矿合作下，首届农业博览会得以组织，旨在促进农业企业，为年轻人创造就业机会，并加强阿丹西地区及以外的农业生产。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-agrif.body: Stakeholders in the agriculture sector in Obuasi and two local municipal assemblies are forging ahead to transform the town from its known status as a gold mining community to a rich agricultural hub to feed the country. In collaboration with AngloGold Ashanti’s Obuasi Mine, the maiden Agrifair is organised to promote agribusiness, create employment opportunities for young people and strengthen agricultural production in the Adansi area and beyond. The maiden fair assembled agricultural producers, processors, buyers, financial institutions, government agencies and other stakeholders to explore partnerships to expand farming businesses and improve productivity. The initiative forms part of activities to commemorate the 2026 World Food Day and reflects the AGA’s 10-year socioeconomic development plan (SEDP), prioritizing sustainable livelihoods, agriculture, enterprise development, skills development and local economic growth. The initiative aimed at creating market opportunities for locally produced agricultural goods while promoting agriculture, agro-processing and local enterprise development. Managing Director of AngloGold Ashanti’s Obuasi Mine, Samuel Pobi, noted that the fair was crucial to strengthening agriculture, promoting local enterprise and creating sustainable economic opportunities. “Our support for agriculture is not new. Through our community development and livelihood interventions, we continue to support initiatives that strengthen agricultural productivity, improve processing capacity and create opportunities for income generation,” he said. The event is expected to provide a platform for farmers and other stakeholders to explore business opportunities, share ideas and identify ways to make agriculture more productive and attractive to young people. Mr. Pobi added that creating opportunities within the agricultural sector could contribute to improved livelihoods and encourage more people, particularly the youth, to consider farming and related businesses as viable sources of income. The program also saw the handover of some agricultural inputs and modern processing equipment to selected farmers and processing groups. Obuasi MCE, Faustilove Appiah Kennin, shared that the town cannot rely on its mineral resources alone for sustainable growth but must also turn to other ventures to promote economic growth. “Obuasi is recognized for its rich mineral resources as the contributory of mining to local and national economy, however, you’d realize that sustainable and economic development requires us to diversify our economic activities and create additional source of employment,” she said. Deputy Minister for Food and Agriculture, John Dumelo, reaffirmed the government’s commitment to supporting farmers with agricultural equipment and inputs to improve productivity and increase food production. He stressed that farmers needed access to the necessary resources to expand their operations and contribute more effectively to the growth of Ghana’s agricultural sector. The fair was held on the theme: “Building Sustainable Agriculture for Food Security and Economic Growth in Obuasi”
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-agrif.title_zh: Obuasi Agrifair促进农业企业、粮食安全和青年就业
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-agrif.body_zh: 奥布阿西农业部门的利益相关者以及两个地方市政议会正在推进将该镇从已知的黄金开采社区转变为一个丰富的农业中心，以养活全国。在与盎格鲁黄金阿散蒂的奥布阿西矿合作下，首届农业博览会得以组织，旨在促进农业企业，为年轻人创造就业机会，并加强阿丹西地区及以外的农业生产。首届博览会聚集了农业生产者、加工者、买家、金融机构、政府机构和其他利益相关者，以探索伙伴关系来扩大农业业务并提高生产力。该举措是纪念2026年世界粮食日活动的一部分，并反映了AGA的10年社会经济发展计划（SEDP），优先考虑可持续生计、农业、企业发展、技能发展和地方经济增长。该举措旨在为当地生产的农产品创造市场机会，同时促进农业、农产品加工和地方企业发展。盎格鲁黄金阿散蒂奥布阿西矿的总经理塞缪尔·波比指出，博览会对加强农业、促进地方企业和创造可持续经济机会至关重要。“我们对农业的支持并不新鲜。通过我们的社区发展和生计干预，我们继续支持加强农业生产力、提高加工能力和创造创收机会的举措，”他说。该活动预计将为农民和其他利益相关者提供一个平台，以探索商业机会、分享想法并找出使农业更具生产力和对年轻人更有吸引力的方法。波比先生补充说，在农业部门创造机会可以有助于改善生计，并鼓励更多人，特别是青年，将农业及相关业务视为可行的收入来源。该计划还见证了向选定的农民和加工团体移交一些农业投入物和现代加工设备。奥布阿西市政行政长官福斯蒂洛夫·阿皮亚·肯宁表示，该镇不能仅仅依靠其矿产资源来实现可持续增长，还必须转向其他企业来促进经济增长。“奥布阿西因其丰富的矿产资源而闻名，因为采矿对地方和国家经济的贡献，然而，你会意识到可持续和经济发展要求我们多样化我们的经济活动并创造额外的就业来源，”她说。粮食和农业部副部长约翰·杜梅洛重申了政府支持农民提供农业设备和投入物以提高生产力和增加粮食生产的承诺。他强调，农民需要获得必要资源来扩大他们的业务并更有效地为加纳农业部门的增长做出贡献。博览会的主题是：“在奥布阿西建设可持续农业以实现粮食安全和经济增长”

https://www.myjoyonline.com/goldbod-must.body: President John Mahama has commended the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) for its contribution to the growth of gold exports, increased foreign exchange earnings and efforts to promote responsible small-scale mining. Speaking at the Mining in Motion Conference, the President highlighted an increase in gold exports from the artisanal and small-scale mining sector, alongside measures to reclaim lands destroyed by illegal mining and improve monitoring of mining equipment. “I wish to commend the Gold Board for the successes that it has chalked,” he said. President Mahama said Ghana exported 64 tonnes of gold from the artisanal and small-scale mining sector in 2024. In 2025, the country exported 104 tonnes from the sector between April and December, following the establishment of GoldBod in April. He said the regulation of small-scale gold exports had also contributed to a significant increase in foreign exchange earnings. “And I'm happy to note that the Gold Board in 2025 alone, with the regulation of export of small-scale gold, brought into this country $10.8 billion, which is an almost 100% increase over the $4.66 billion that came into the country in 2024,” he said. The President's remarks come as the government seeks to strengthen the regulation of gold trading, increase the economic benefits of the mining sector and address the environmental damage associated with illegal mining. President Mahama said the government had made progress in removing illegal miners from nine designated high-risk areas, with work now underway to prepare the affected forest reserves for reclamation. “I'm happy to note that of those nine red zones, we have cleared all of them of illegal miners and are currently preparing those forest reserves for reclamation,” he said. He said that illegal mining had destroyed approximately 12,000 acres of land across Ghana, making the restoration of affected areas a key priority. The President commended mining company Newmont for its reclamation work, saying it had restored almost 800 acres of mined-out land and planted useful crops. He also praised GoldBod for awarding the Ghana Armed Forces a contract to reclaim 253 acres of land damaged by mining activities in the Tano-Nimiri Forest. “The Gold Board has awarded the Ghana Armed Forces a contract to reclaim 253 acres of land destroyed in the famous Tano-Nimiri Forest. That work is ongoing,” he said. President Mahama further commended the Ministers of Lands and Natural Resources and Finance for allocating GH¢200 million towards the reclamation of 5,000 acres of degraded land, with the work expected to begin in 2027. The planned restoration forms part of broader efforts to repair environmental damage caused by illegal mining and protect forest reserves from further degradation. The President also outlined measures to strengthen monitoring of excavators and improve oversight of mining activities across the country. He said 6,060 excavators had been registered and detained at the ports, while 2,059 had been fitted with tracking devices to help authorities monitor their locations and use. The tracking system is intended to help the authorities identify where the equipment is being deployed and strengthen efforts to prevent its use in illegal mining operations. President Mahama also said 11 cooperatives had been trained in new mining methods and were now operational. He added that GoldBod was financing small-scale artisanal mining operations to adopt technologies designed to reduce environmental destruction. The initiative is intended to support miners in adopting improved methods while reducing the damage associated with mining activities. President Mahama said the government was also allocating funds to strengthen efforts to tackle illegal mining and protect the country's water bodies.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/goldbod-must.title_zh: GoldBod必须因取得的成功而受到赞扬——马哈马
https://www.myjoyonline.com/goldbod-must.body_zh: 总统约翰·马哈马赞扬了加纳黄金局（GoldBod）对黄金出口增长、外汇收入增加以及促进负责任的小规模采矿所作出的贡献。在“采矿在进行”会议上发表讲话时，总统强调了来自手工和小规模采矿部门的黄金出口增加，以及收回被非法采矿破坏的土地和改善采矿设备监测的措施。“我想赞扬黄金局所取得的成功，”他说。马哈马总统说，加纳在2024年从手工和小规模采矿部门出口了64吨黄金。2025年，该国在4月至12月期间从该部门出口了104吨黄金，此前黄金局于4月成立。他说，小规模黄金出口的监管也为外汇收入的显著增加做出了贡献。“我很高兴地注意到，黄金局仅在2025年，通过监管小规模黄金出口，就为这个国家带来了108亿美元，这几乎是2024年进入该国的46.6亿美元的100%增长，”他说。总统的言论是在政府寻求加强黄金交易监管、增加采矿部门的经济效益并解决与非法采矿相关的环境破坏之际发表的。马哈马总统说，政府已在清除九个指定的高风险地区的非法矿工方面取得了进展，目前正在为受影响的森林保护区进行恢复准备。“我很高兴地注意到，在那九个红色区域中，我们已经清除了所有的非法矿工，目前正在为那些森林保护区进行恢复准备，”他说。他说，非法采矿已经摧毁了加纳大约12000英亩的土地，使受影响地区的恢复成为关键优先事项。总统赞扬了矿业公司Newmont的恢复工作，说它已经恢复了近800英亩的采矿土地并种植了有用的作物。他还赞扬黄金局授予加纳武装部队一份合同，以恢复在Tano-Nimiri森林中被采矿活动破坏的253英亩土地。“黄金局已授予加纳武装部队一份合同，以恢复在著名的Tano-Nimiri森林中被破坏的253英亩土地。那项工作正在进行中，”他说。马哈马总统进一步赞扬了土地和自然资源部长以及财政部长，他们拨款2亿塞地用于恢复5000英亩退化土地，预计该工作将于2027年开始。计划中的恢复是更广泛努力的一部分，旨在修复非法采矿造成的环境破坏，并保护森林保护区免受进一步退化。总统还概述了加强挖掘机监测和改善全国采矿活动监督的措施。他说，6060台挖掘机已在港口注册并被扣留，而2059台已安装了跟踪设备，以帮助当局监测它们的位置和使用情况。该跟踪系统旨在帮助当局确定设备被部署的位置，并加强防止其用于非法采矿行动的努力。马哈马总统还说，已经培训了11个合作社采用新的采矿方法，现在它们已经开始运作。他补充说，黄金局正在为小规模手工采矿作业提供资金，以采用旨在减少环境破坏的技术。该举措旨在支持矿工采用改进的方法，同时减少与采矿活动相关的破坏。马哈马总统说，政府还在拨款以加强打击非法采矿和保护该国水体的努力。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Cross River State Government has banned the activities of roadside mechanics and street traders in Calabar metropolis effective 31 October. The Commissioner for Environment, Bassey Mensah, disclosed this during an on-the-spot inspection of business areas, erosion sites, and other locations in Calabar on Monday. Mr Mensah said roadside technicians and traders were obstructing pedestrian and vehicular movement in the city. The commissioner also said their activities had caused serious environmental degradation in Calabar City. The News Agency of Nigeria reports that during the inspection, Mr Mensah visited Kings Street, White House, Bedwell, Punch, Victor Akan and adjoining streets. He told roadside mechanics and traders in the area to relocate their operations to designated places. “There is the possibility of exposure to harmful chemicals; we need to collectively protect public health and restore environmental order,” he said. Mr Mensah said improved sanitation is critical to creating a safe environment for residents. The commissioner expressed the government’s commitment to address environmental degradation triggered by roadside workshops and street trading. He said the state government would collaborate with the Nigeria Climate Adaptation–Erosion and Watershed Project to tackle the matter. He said the inspection was part of the ministry’s ongoing efforts to restore a clean, healthy environment in the state through improved sanitation, enforcement of environmental regulations, and sustained public sensitisation. Ndem Effiong, the senior special assistant to Governor Bassey Otu on the Automobile Technician Regulatory Department, said vehicle sales and mechanic operations need to be separated. He expressed concern about increasing environmental degradation caused by mechanics operating on the streets

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 克罗斯河州政府已禁止路边机械师和街头商贩在卡拉巴尔都市区的活动，该禁令自10月31日起生效。环境专员巴塞·门萨在周一对卡拉巴尔的商业区、侵蚀现场和其他地点进行现场检查时披露了这一消息。门萨先生表示，路边技师和商贩阻碍了城市中行人和车辆的通行。该专员还表示，他们的活动已导致卡拉巴尔市严重的环境退化。尼日利亚通讯社报道称，在检查期间，门萨先生走访了Kings Street、White House、Bedwell、Punch、Victor Akan及周边街道。他告诉该地区的路边机械师和商贩将他们的经营活动搬迁到指定地点。“存在接触有害化学品的可能性；我们需要共同保护公众健康并恢复环境秩序，”他说。门萨先生表示，改善卫生状况对于为居民创造安全环境至关重要。该专员表达了政府致力于解决由路边作坊和街头贸易引发的环境退化问题的决心。他说州政府将与尼日利亚气候适应-侵蚀和流域项目合作来处理此事。他说此次检查是该部通过改善卫生、执行环境法规和持续开展公众宣传来恢复该州清洁、健康环境的持续努力的一部分。Ndem Effiong是州长Bassey Otu在汽车技师监管部门的资深特别助理，他表示车辆销售和机械师操作需要分开。他对机械师在街道上作业导致的环境退化日益严重表示担忧

https://www.myjoyonline.com/galamsey-pre.body: President John Mahama has commended Newmont for reclaiming 800 acres of degraded land and putting it to use for crop farming. Speaking at the Mining in Motion conference on Monday, 19th October, the President acknowledged the mining company’s contribution to restoring devastated land for agricultural production. His remarks came as he disclosed that 12,000 acres of land in Ghana had been affected by illegal mining, commonly known as galamsey, with reclamation underway. "Illegal mining has destroyed approximately 12,000 acres of land in Ghana. We have currently embarked on the reclamation of these forest reserves, and I want to commend Newmont for the excellent work they are doing in the area of reclamation. Newmont has reclaimed 800 acres of mining outlines and planted them with useful crops," he said at the conference. President Mahama also said 48 of the country’s 288 forest reserves had been affected by illegal mining. According to him, the affected reserves had since been recovered and were undergoing restoration. Newmont’s mining operations in Ghana include Ahafo South, which began commercial production in 2006 and combines open-pit and underground gold mining. The company expanded its operations with Ahafo North, which reached commercial production in October 2025. The operation comprises four open-pit mines and a stand-alone processing mill, with an initial mine life of 13 years. Newmont previously operated the Akyem mine but sold it in April 2025, leaving Ahafo South and Ahafo North as its two operational sites in Ghana

https://www.myjoyonline.com/galamsey-pre.body_zh: 总统约翰·马哈马赞扬纽蒙特复垦了800英亩退化土地并将其用于农作物种植。在10月19日星期一举行的‘Mining in Motion’会议上发言时，总统承认了这家矿业公司为恢复受损土地用于农业生产所做的贡献。他的这番言论是在披露加纳有12,000英亩土地受到非法采矿（俗称加拉姆塞）影响且复垦工作正在进行时发表的。他说：“非法采矿已摧毁了加纳约12,000英亩土地。我们目前已着手对这些森林保护区进行复垦，我想赞扬纽蒙特在复垦领域所做的出色工作。纽蒙特已复垦了800英亩采矿轮廓并在上面种植了有用的作物。”马哈马总统还表示，该国288个森林保护区中有48个受到非法采矿影响。据他介绍，受影响的保护区此后已收回并正在进行恢复。纽蒙特在加纳的采矿业务包括阿哈福南部，该项目于2006年开始商业生产，结合露天和地下金矿开采。该公司通过阿哈福北部扩大了业务，该项目于2025年10月达到商业生产。该业务包括四个露天矿和一个独立加工厂，初始矿山寿命为13年。纽蒙特此前经营阿基姆矿，但于2025年4月将其出售，使阿哈福南部和阿哈福北部成为其在加纳的两个运营站点。

But as concerns Listen to this article Share In Nigeria’s competitive market for slimming products, the promise of a different body can be commercially powerful. But as concerns grow over product safety, effectiveness and marketing claims, ShapesLagos faces a defining test: whether a business built around body confidence can establish a lasting reputation grounded in evidence, transparency and responsible customer care. Founded by Lovelyn Okofu, ShapesLagos grew from her interest in fashion, body confidence and the challenges some women face in managing their weight, particularly after childbirth. What began as a desire to help women feel more comfortable in their bodies has developed into a wellness brand operating in an increasingly crowded weight-management market. Yet aspiration alone is not enough. Dramatic before-and-after photographs and customer testimonials can attract buyers, but individual experiences do not establish that a product caused a particular result or guarantee similar outcomes for others. For ShapesLagos, the opportunity is to turn its founding vision into a business that supports informed choices and responsibly communicates its products’ benefits and limitations. A brand rooted in body confidence Body image and weight management are deeply personal. Some women seek to manage changes after childbirth; others pursue broader health, fitness or personal goals. Diet, physical activity, sleep, underlying health conditions and individual metabolism can all influence outcomes. No single approach works identically for everyone. ShapesLagos offers WP Fat Blaster, Oolong Tea, Skinny Coffee, Dietary Fiber Protein Shake, Burn and Sum, and Flat Tummy Blaster. This range gives the company several product categories through which to engage consumers interested in weight management and nutritional support. It also makes accurate labelling, clear usage instructions and substantiated marketing essential. Customers need to know what each product contains, its intended purpose, how it should be used and what limitations may apply. Claims about weight loss or other health benefits should be supported by reliable evidence relevant to the finished product, rather than assumptions based solely on natural ingredients. Natural does not automatically mean safe. Ingredients can cause side effects, interact with medication or be unsuitable for people with particular medical conditions. Nor does a product’s advertised purpose establish its effectiveness. Consumers who are pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication or managing an existing health condition should seek qualified medical advice where appropriate. Beyond testimonials Social media has become an important channel for wellness brands to build awareness and share customer experiences. But testimonials have clear limitations. Someone who reports losing weight after using a supplement may also have changed their diet, increased physical activity or adopted other lifestyle habits. Without appropriate evidence, it is difficult to establish how much of the result can be attributed to the product. Testimonials should therefore be presented as individual experiences, not universal promises or substitutes for scientific research. For ShapesLagos, credible communication means explaining the basis for advertised benefits, avoiding guarantees of rapid weight loss and disclosing material limitations. Any scientific or clinical evidence cited should be genuine, relevant to the specific product and available for appropriate scrutiny. The same standard applies to customer support. ShapesLagos places emphasis on guiding first-time users on how to use its products. Such guidance can help consumers understand labels, recommended directions and relevant precautions, but it should not be confused with medical supervision.
https://businessday.ng/news/article/nige.title_zh: 尼日利亚瘦身市场面临信任考验，ShapesLagos寻求增长
https://businessday.ng/news/article/nige.body_zh: 在尼日利亚竞争激烈的减肥产品市场中，塑造不同身材的承诺可能具有强大的商业影响力。但随着人们对产品安全性、有效性和营销声明的担忧日益增加，ShapesLagos面临一项决定性考验：一家围绕身体自信建立的企业能否确立基于证据、透明度和负责任客户关怀的持久声誉。该品牌由Lovelyn Okofu创立，ShapesLagos源于她对时尚、身体自信以及一些女性在管理体重方面面临的挑战的兴趣，特别是分娩后。最初帮助女性在自己身体中感到更舒适的愿望已发展成为一个在日益拥挤的体重管理市场中运营的健康品牌。然而，仅有抱负是不够的。戏剧性的前后对比照片和客户推荐可以吸引买家，但个人经历并不能证明某种产品导致了特定结果或保证其他人获得类似结果。对于ShapesLagos来说，机会在于将其创始愿景转变为支持知情选择并负责任地传达其产品益处和局限性的企业。以身体自信为根基的品牌 身体形象和体重管理是非常个人的。有些女性寻求管理分娩后的变化；其他人追求更广泛的健康、健身或个人目标。饮食、身体活动、睡眠、潜在健康状况和个人新陈代谢都可能影响结果。没有单一方法对每个人都完全相同。ShapesLagos提供WP Fat Blaster、Oolong Tea、Skinny Coffee、Dietary Fiber Protein Shake、Burn and Sum以及Flat Tummy Blaster。该系列使公司拥有多个产品类别，通过这些类别与对体重管理和营养支持感兴趣的消费者互动。这也使得准确的标签、清晰的使用说明和有依据的营销变得必不可少。客户需要知道每种产品包含什么、其预期用途、应如何使用以及可能适用的局限性。关于减重或其他健康益处的声明应得到与成品相关的可靠证据支持，而不是仅仅基于天然成分的假设。天然并不自动意味着安全。成分可能导致副作用、与药物相互作用或不适合患有特定疾病的人。产品的广告目的也不能确立其有效性。孕妇、哺乳期妇女、正在服药或管理现有健康状况的消费者应在适当情况下寻求合格的医疗建议。超越推荐 社交媒体已成为健康品牌建立知名度和分享客户体验的重要渠道。但推荐有明显的局限性。报告在使用补充剂后减重的人可能还改变了饮食、增加了身体活动或采用了其他生活方式习惯。在没有适当证据的情况下，很难确定结果中有多少可以归因于该产品。因此，推荐应作为个人经历呈现，而不是普遍承诺或科学研究的替代品。对于ShapesLagos来说，可信的沟通意味着解释广告益处的依据，避免保证快速减重并披露重要局限性。引用的任何科学或临床证据都应是真实的、与特定产品相关的，并且可供适当审查。同样的标准适用于客户支持。ShapesLagos强调指导首次使用者如何使用其产品。此类指导可以帮助消费者理解标签、推荐用法和相关注意事项，但不应与医疗监督混淆。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/ndc-youth-ch.body: Members of the Youth Wing of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) have been urged to double their propagation of government policies and programs, grassroots mobilization efforts, and expand membership drives to secure the party’s victory and maintain its parliamentary majority in the 2028 general elections. Addressing student leaders and party activists, Masahudu emphasized that securing power in 2028 is vital to sustaining the socioeconomic progress and governance reforms under President John Mahama’s Resetting Ghana agenda. "We must win the next general elections to continuously put Ghana in the right direction, and it starts with your effective participation and collaboration as young persons in our party. You will play a very strategic role in retaining power come 2028," Masahudu urged. He entreated youth leaders, digital advocacy teams, and student groups not to relent in communicating the administration's policy achievements to all citizens, including members of the opposition New Patriotic Party (NPP). The charge comes on the heels of the NDC’s decisive victory in the 2024 general elections, where John Dramani Mahama secured the presidency with 6,328,397 votes, representing 56.55 percent, defeating the NPP’s Mahamudu Bawumia, who garnered 4,975,183 votes, recording 44.48 percent. In Parliament, the party established a dominant majority in Ghana’s 9th Parliament, capturing over 180 seats compared to the NPP’s over 80 seats. According to Masahudu, the party remains highly attractive to voters, making an even wider victory margin achievable in 2028 through strategic operations across auxiliary youth groups including TEIN, elections directorates, research and innovation units, and digital communications teams. The Youth Organizer further noted the rollout of the One Million Coders digital skills training program and the Adwumawura Programme designed to supply funding and mentorship to youth startups, as Basic and senior high schools have also received direct distributions under a free sanitary pad program. Additional landmark achievements, he stated, include the enactment of free tuition and academic fees for all first-year students entering public tertiary institutions, along with the institutionalization of full academic and residential scholarships for Persons with Disabilities in public universities. Mr. Masahudu indicated that in healthcare and agriculture, the Mahama Cares framework has expanded primary healthcare access at polyclinics and CHPS compounds under National Health Insurance Scheme coverage. The Youth Organizer said the district-level Farmers’ Service Centers have been established to provide smallholder farmers with pre-financed inputs, machinery leasing, and technical support

Getting there Listen to this article Share InnovateNaija’s winners are building for markets worth billions of dollars, from poultry to fish farming to medical diagnostics. Getting there depends on what happens after the prize money lands. NASENI handed out ₦435.5 million on 7 October across four competitions: InnovateNaija, FutureMakers and its Intra-Agency and Inter-Agency innovation challenges. Of that, ₦150 million went to InnovateNaija’s top three, with ₦100 million, ₦30 million and ₦20 million for first, second and third place. Three Inter-Agency winners shared ₦140 million in development grants, three Intra-Agency winners took ₦22.5 million, and six young FutureMakers finalists shared ₦23 million. Those numbers will make headlines, but the people who designed the programme are clear that prize money is the start of the work. Busola Perez-Folayan, head of the NASENI Innovation Hub, said the aim is to help innovators build solutions that can “survive, grow and reach the market”. Why commercialisation is the hard part The Minister of Innovation, Science and Technology, Dr Kingsley Tochukwu Udeh, framed commercialisation as the reason the programme exists. Turning research into products, he said, lets innovators “generate revenue from their work while contributing to economic growth”, along with jobs and better livelihoods. He also disclosed that President Tinubu has sent a bill to the National Assembly to create a National Research and Innovation Development Fund, which would give dedicated financing to inventions with commercial potential. The finalists’ own accounts show why such a fund is needed. Zang Luka of Plateau State, whose company Zang Global makes a foot-operated computer mouse and Nigerian-made USB cables, said his product is already on sale but production has not scaled. About 40 per cent of his materials are sourced locally, and the rest are imported. Kemisola Bolarinwa of Ekiti State has a working prototype of EwaDX, a wearable device for early breast cancer detection, but it must pass clinical trials and NAFDAC certification before it can be sold. Each case points to the same gap: equipment, testing, regulatory approval and patient capital. The size of the markets in play The winning innovations are aimed at markets large enough to support real companies. A climate-control system that saves even a small share of birds lost each year, or a pond-monitoring tool that lifts yields on fish farms, is competing for a slice of these markets. The fish deficit alone is a gap that imports currently fill. What it means for the wider economy AfriLabs Director of Programmes Nanko Madu argued that Nigeria’s dependence on imported technology carries a hidden cost. Foreign products, she said, are often not designed for Nigeria’s power supply, climate, languages, or purchasing power. Home-built solutions that fit local conditions can compete on those terms, and every unit made here keeps manufacturing jobs and spending in the country. She also made a point about where that value can come from. Running InnovateNaija across all 36 states and the FCT showed that inventive talent is spread well beyond the Lagos-Abuja corridor, and that the real constraint is “a lack of access and opportunity”. State governments are starting to act on that idea. The governors of Abia, Anambra, Enugu, Plateau and Kaduna matched the ₦2.5 million grants for their state champions, doubling each to ₦5 million. Anambra’s Special Adviser on Innovation and Business Incubation, Chinwe Okoli, said the state has already put about ₦364 million into 111 startups, trained 264,000 people in digital skills, and is developing a 13.7-hectare Solution Innovation District.

https://businessday.ng/brands-advertisin.body_zh: 阅读历史 前往我的账户 登出 品牌与广告 InnovateNaija的获奖者正在为价值数十亿美元的市场进行建设，从家禽养殖到鱼类养殖再到医疗诊断。取得成功取决于奖金到账后会发生什么。NASENI于10月7日在四项竞赛中发放了₦435.5 million：InnovateNaija、FutureMakers及其内部机构和机构间创新挑战。其中，₦150 million 给了InnovateNaija的前三名，第一名₦100 million、第二名₦30 million、第三名₦20 million。三名机构间获奖者分享了₦140 million的发展补助金，三名内部机构获奖者获得了₦22.5 million，六名年轻的FutureMakers决赛选手分享了₦23 million。这些数字会成为头条新闻，但设计该计划的人明确表示，奖金只是工作的开始。NASENI创新中心负责人Busola Perez-Folayan表示，目标是帮助创新者构建能够“生存、成长并进入市场”的解决方案。为什么商业化是困难的部分 创新、科学与技术部长Kingsley Tochukwu Udeh博士将商业化描述为该计划存在的原因。他说，将研究转化为产品，让创新者“从他们的工作中产生收入，同时为经济增长做出贡献”，并带来就业和更好的生计。他还透露，Tinubu总统已向国民议会提交了一项法案，以创建国家研究与创新发展基金，该基金将为具有商业潜力的发明提供专用融资。决赛选手自己的叙述显示了为什么需要这样的基金。来自高原州的Zang Luka，他的公司Zang Global生产一种脚控电脑鼠标和尼日利亚制造的USB电缆，他说他的产品已经在销售，但生产尚未扩大。他的材料约40%来自本地，其余为进口。来自埃基蒂州的Kemisola Bolarinwa有一个可穿戴设备EwaDX的工作原型，用于早期乳腺癌检测，但它必须通过临床试验和NAFDAC认证才能销售。每个案例都指向同一个差距：设备、测试、监管批准和患者资本。所涉及的市场规模 获奖创新针对的市场足够大，足以支持真正的公司。一个气候控制系统即使只挽救每年损失的少量禽鸟，或一个池塘监测工具能提高鱼类养殖场的产量，也是在争夺这些市场的一小部分。仅鱼类赤字就是一个目前由进口填补的缺口。这对更广泛经济的意义 AfriLabs项目总监Nanko Madu认为，尼日利亚对进口技术的依赖带来了隐性成本。她说，外国产品通常不是为尼日利亚的电力供应、气候、语言或购买力设计的。适合当地条件的本土解决方案可以在这些条件下竞争，而且在这里制造的每一件产品都能将制造业就业和支出留在国内。她还就这种价值可能来自哪里提出了一个观点。在所有36个州和联邦首都特区举办InnovateNaija表明，创新人才远远超出拉各斯-阿布贾走廊的范围，真正的限制是“缺乏机会和途径”。州政府正在开始对这一想法采取行动。阿比亚州、阿南布拉州、埃努古州、高原州和卡杜纳州的州长为他们州的冠军匹配了₦2.5 million的补助金，将每笔翻倍至₦5 million。阿南布拉州创新与商业孵化特别顾问Chinwe Okoli表示，该州已经向111家初创企业投入约₦364 million，对26.4万人进行了数字技能培训，并正在开发一个13.7公顷的解决方案创新区。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/ablakwa-anno.body: The Minister for Foreign Affairs, Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, has announced that the Foreign Ministry has established what he describes as the first comprehensive database of Ghanaians living across the world, with particular attention to those requiring diplomatic and consular assistance. He said the initiative forms part of the government’s commitment to protecting the welfare and dignity of Ghanaians, regardless of where they reside. Mr Ablakwa disclosed this while congratulating four career diplomats recently commissioned by President John Dramani Mahama to represent Ghana in various countries and at international institutions. The newly commissioned diplomats are Nana Antwiwaa Dodoo, appointed to Angola; Louis Kwame Obeng, to Qatar; Evelyn Korantemaa Ofosu-Amable, to Israel; and Jedidiah Reuben Adogla, who will serve as Ghana’s Permanent Representative to the United Nations Office in Geneva, Switzerland. The Foreign Affairs Minister expressed confidence in their experience and ability to represent Ghana effectively in their respective jurisdictions. He also emphasised that ambassadors and high commissioners would be expected to meet their key performance indicators (KPIs), with particular focus on the welfare of Ghanaians abroad and the provision of consular assistance. "Government expects our Ambassadors and High Commissioners to meet their KPIs and focus on the welfare and consular assistance of Ghanaians in their destinations. "The Foreign Ministry has created the first comprehensive database of Ghanaians across the world with special emphasis on those in need of diplomatic and consular support. "We shall continue to fiercely safeguard the welfare and dignity of all Ghanaians everywhere in the world," he wrote on X

https://www.myjoyonline.com/experts-call.summary: Researchers, regulators and civil society leaders have called for stronger community participation, tighter enforcement of environmental regulations and better ocean data systems, warning that pollution, coastal erosion and depleted fish stocks are threatening the livelihoods of thousands of people along Ghana's coastline.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/experts-call.summary_zh: 研究人员、监管机构和公民社会领导人呼吁加强社区参与、严格执行环境法规和更好的海洋数据系统，他们警告说，污染、海岸侵蚀和鱼类资源枯竭正在威胁加纳海岸线沿岸数千人的生计。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/experts-call.body: Researchers, regulators and civil society leaders have called for stronger community participation, tighter enforcement of environmental regulations and better ocean data systems, warning that pollution, coastal erosion and depleted fish stocks are threatening the livelihoods of thousands of people along Ghana's coastline. The call came from the Ghana Ocean Dialogue, held under the theme “Shaping Our Blue Economy” and organised by Emerging Climate Frontiers (ECF) and the Ghana Marine Climate Innovation Hub, in partnership with the University of Cape Coast (UCC) in Cape Coast. The dialogue brought together researchers, policy experts, environmental regulators, civil society leaders, and youth advocates to discuss how Ghana can protect its marine space while tapping the ocean's economic potential. Participants noted that from the port cities of Tema and Takoradi to fishing communities in the Central and Volta regions, the sea drives trade, feeds families and shapes coastal culture. However, many beaches are now littered with plastic, retreating under erosion and recording dwindling fish catches. Delivering a solidarity message, Prof Simon Mariwah, Provost of the College of Humanities and Legal Studies at UCC, noted that much of the plastic washed ashore along Ghana's coast does not come from beachgoers or fishermen but from communities far inland. Participants also pointed to illegal small-scale mining (galamsey), which discharges heavy metals and silt into rivers that empty into the sea, as well as the use of banned chemicals such as DDT and re-labelled toxic agrochemicals in fishing. Other threats discussed included shoreline erosion and sea-level rise, which are sweeping away homes, heritage sites and landing beaches, and overfishing. The dialogue proposed a framework for a sustainable ocean economy built on five pillars: Blue Wealth, Blue Health, Blue Knowledge, Blue Finance and Blue Equity. On behalf of the Centre for Coastal Management, Dr Dorothy Khasisi Lukhabi said Ghana's ocean future depends on deliberate action and the full implementation of ocean policies aimed at a resilient blue economy by 2035. She called for stronger institutional coordination, public accountability and evidence-based decision-making, as well as the protection of natural coastal defences. Edem Alipo, a Carbon Dioxide Removal Fellow at ECF, launched the Ghana Marine Climate Innovation Hub, which seeks to bridge the gap between academic research and policy. Dr Anim cautioned that emerging climate interventions, such as ocean alkalinity enhancement, which aims to increase the ocean's capacity to absorb carbon dioxide, must undergo rigorous feasibility testing before introduction. She stressed that such technologies must respect local realities and integrate scientific research with indigenous knowledge. Panellists noted that resistance from coastal communities often stems from fears of lost livelihoods, unfulfilled promises, or a lack of consultation. Prof Nyarko argued that indigenous traditions, including spiritual and customary practices for managing the sea, must be integrated into modern coastal governance. He added that direct engagement and clear communication are needed to help communities understand that environmental regulations ultimately protect their future. Ms Tampuri called for education on sustainable practices, the involvement of school children in ocean stewardship, and transparent research that delivers visible benefits to local people. On data, Ms Djaba outlined the EPA's efforts to build data vulnerability hubs and to work with academia on a shared geospatial database to support evidence-based policy and access to carbon markets. On financing, Prof Nyarko and Dr Anim called for a unified ocean financing architecture.

https://www.myjoyonline.com/experts-call.body_zh: 研究人员、监管机构和公民社会领袖呼吁加强社区参与、严格执行环境法规并改善海洋数据系统，他们警告说，污染、海岸侵蚀和鱼类资源枯竭正威胁着加纳海岸线沿岸数千人的生计。这一呼吁来自加纳海洋对话，该对话以“塑造我们的蓝色经济”为主题，由新兴气候前沿（ECF）和加纳海洋气候创新中心主办，与位于海岸角的海岸角大学（UCC）合作举办。对话汇集了研究人员、政策专家、环境监管者、公民社会领袖和青年倡导者，讨论加纳如何在保护其海洋空间的同时挖掘海洋的经济潜力。与会者指出，从特马和塔科拉迪的港口城市到中部和沃尔特地区的渔业社区，海洋驱动着贸易、养育着家庭并塑造着沿海文化。然而，许多海滩现在布满塑料，在侵蚀下后退，鱼类捕捞量不断减少。在发表团结信息时，海岸角大学人文与法律研究学院院长西蒙·马里瓦教授指出，加纳海岸沿岸冲上岸的大部分塑料并非来自海滩游客或渔民，而是来自遥远的内陆社区。与会者还指出非法小规模采矿（galamsey），它将重金属和淤泥排放到流入海洋的河流中，以及在捕鱼中使用被禁化学品如滴滴涕和重新贴标签的有毒农用化学品。讨论的其他威胁包括海岸线侵蚀和海平面上升，这些正在冲走房屋、遗产遗址和登陆海滩，以及过度捕捞。对话提出了一个建立在五个支柱上的可持续海洋经济框架：蓝色财富、蓝色健康、蓝色知识、蓝色金融和蓝色公平。代表海岸管理中心的多萝西·卡西西·卢哈比博士表示，加纳的海洋未来取决于有意的行动以及到2035年旨在实现有韧性的蓝色经济的海洋政策的全面实施。她呼吁加强机构协调、公共问责制和基于证据的决策，以及保护自然的海岸防御。ECF的二氧化碳去除研究员埃德姆·阿利波启动了加纳海洋气候创新中心，该中心旨在弥合学术研究与政策之间的差距。阿尼姆博士警告说，新兴的气候干预措施，例如旨在增加海洋吸收二氧化碳能力的海洋碱度增强，必须在引入前经过严格的可行性测试。她强调，此类技术必须尊重当地现实，并将科学研究与本土知识相结合。小组成员指出，沿海社区的抵制往往源于对失去生计、未兑现的承诺或缺乏协商的担忧。尼亚科教授认为，包括管理海洋的精神和习惯做法在内的本土传统，必须融入现代沿海治理。他补充说，需要直接参与和清晰沟通来帮助社区理解环境法规最终保护他们的未来。坦普里女士呼吁对可持续做法进行教育，让在校儿童参与海洋管理，并开展透明的研究，为当地人民带来可见的利益。在数据方面，贾巴女士概述了环保局建立数据脆弱性中心并与学术界合作建立共享地理空间数据库的努力，以支持基于证据的政策和进入碳市场的机会。在融资方面，尼亚科教授和阿尼姆博士呼吁建立统一的海洋融资架构。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-pushe.body: President John Dramani Mahama says Ghana is working to increase the economic benefits it derives from its gold resources by expanding local assaying, refining and related services. The initiative, being implemented through the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) and the country’s gold refining policy, is intended to deepen domestic participation in the gold value chain and reduce dependence on the extraction and export of raw minerals. Addressing the Mining in Motion Conference on Monday, October 19, President Mahama underscored the importance of building local capacity to process minerals and undertake other value-added activities to ensure that more of the wealth generated from Ghana’s natural resources stays in the country. “Through the Ghana Gold Board and our gold refining policy, we are working to retain more value through assaying, refining, and related services,” he said. The policy is expected to enhance Ghana’s ability to test and refine gold domestically while creating opportunities for local businesses and professionals in the mining and mineral processing industries. The move is part of broader efforts to strengthen Ghana’s position in the gold value chain and maximise the economic returns from its mineral resources
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-pushe.title_zh: 马哈马推动本地黄金精炼以提升加纳的经济收益
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-pushe.body_zh: 总统约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马表示，加纳正努力通过扩大本地化验、精炼及相关服务来增加从黄金资源中获得的经济利益。该举措通过加纳黄金局（GoldBod）和国家黄金精炼政策实施，旨在深化国内对黄金价值链的参与并减少对原材料矿物开采和出口的依赖。10月19日星期一在“Mining in Motion”会议上发表讲话时，马哈马总统强调了建设本地能力以加工矿物并开展其他增值活动的重要性，以确保加纳自然资源产生的更多财富留在国内。“通过加纳黄金局和我们的黄金精炼政策，我们正努力通过化验、精炼和相关服务保留更多价值，”他说。该政策有望提升加纳在国内测试和精炼黄金的能力，同时为采矿和矿物加工行业的本地企业和专业人士创造机会。此举是加强加纳在黄金价值链中地位并最大化矿产资源经济回报的更广泛努力的一部分

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: Seven students expelled by the Federal University Dutse ( FUD ), Jigawa State, have served the institution a pre-action notice, demanding their immediate reinstatement and N200 million in damages. The notice, issued on 15 October, was signed by their counsel, Garba Umaru. The students are Emmanuel Anenechukwu, Mubarak Usman, Divine Inuwa, Yusuf Lawal, Ismail Idris, Ayomide Kayode, and Miracle Kayode. According to official correspondence dated 8 September, the university expelled the students after a police report indicted them and they were subsequently arraigned before Chief Magistrate Courts II and III in Dutse for alleged criminal conspiracy and armed robbery. In the letter addressed to the the university’s vice-chancellor, Ahmad Gumel, the counsel described their expulsion as hasty, uninformed, and a breach of the Nigerian constitution. Mr Umaru said the police report relied upon by the university is merely investigative and that no competent court has convicted the students of any crime. Mr Umaru said the university’s disciplinary committee did not invite or afford the students an opportunity to defend themselves before reaching a “guilty verdict” and recommending their expulsion under Section 31 of the student handbook. The lawyer noted that the charges against the students in court differ from the armed robbery allegations cited by the university. He further pointed out that chief magistrate courts lack jurisdiction to try capital offences such as armed robbery. The lawyer decried the publication of the students’ names, photographs, and academic records across various news and online platforms, stating that depicting them as “petty criminals” has inflicted severe psychological trauma and irreparable damage on their reputations and family standing. The solicitor gave the university management two weeks to unconditionally reverse the expulsion and reinstate the students with full access to university facilities, student privileges, and the return of their ID cards. “Special arrangements enabling the affected students to write the examinations they were barred from taking. “Payment of N200,000,000 (Two Hundred Million Naira) in damages for public ridicule, defamation, embarrassment, and psychological trauma,” the expelled students demanded. The university’s spokesperson, Abdullahi Bello, could not be reached through his known phone number for his comments on the development. On 16 September, the Federal University Dutse published the names and photographs of seven students in its internal bulletin, which announced their expulsion. Their alleged offences included criminal conspiracy, armed robbery, cultism, drug abuse, cyberbullying, and attempted sexual assault. According to the publication, 12 students were expelled, and five others were rusticated. It said the decisions were approved at the 20th Students’ Disciplinary Committee. It said Emmanuel Anenechukwu, Ayomide Peter, Idris Ismail, Miracle Pelumi, Yazi Saleh, and Yusuf Abdurrazak were expelled for criminal conspiracy and armed robbery. Also, Mubarak Usman and Divine Inuwa were expelled over allegations of robbery and cult-related activities, while Ahmed Bashir was expelled following allegations of phone theft. In addition, drug abuse allegations on campus led to the expulsion of Ismail Muhammad, Aisha Yakubu, and Fatima Muhammad. Five other students were rusticated for alleged offences relating to cyberbullying and attempted sexual assault. Four of them received a two-semester suspension, while one was suspended for one semester
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: 学生威胁以诉讼起诉大学开除决定
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 联邦大学杜策（FUD）位于吉加瓦州，被该校开除的七名学生已向学校发出诉前通知，要求立即恢复他们的学籍并赔偿2亿奈拉。该通知于10月15日发出，由他们的律师加尔巴·乌马鲁签署。这些学生是Emmanuel Anenechukwu、Mubarak Usman、Divine Inuwa、Yusuf Lawal、Ismail Idris、Ayomide Kayode和Miracle Kayode。根据9月8日的官方函件，大学在警方报告指控他们后开除了这些学生，随后他们在杜策首席地方法院II和III接受了 arraignment，指控罪名是涉嫌刑事共谋和持械抢劫。在致大学副校长的信中，律师艾哈迈德·古梅尔称他们的开除是仓促的、未经证实的，并且违反了尼日利亚宪法。乌马鲁先生表示，大学所依赖的警方报告仅仅是调查性的，没有任何有管辖权的法院判定这些学生犯有任何罪行。乌马鲁先生说，大学的纪律委员会没有邀请或给予学生机会在做出“有罪判决”并根据学生手册第31条建议开除他们之前为自己辩护。律师指出，法庭上对学生的指控与大学所称的持械抢劫指控不同。他进一步指出，首席地方法院没有审理持械抢劫等死刑罪行的管辖权。律师谴责将学生的姓名、照片和学业记录在各种新闻和在线平台上公布，称将他们描绘成“轻罪罪犯”给他们造成了严重的心理创伤，并对其声誉和家庭地位造成了不可挽回的损害。律师给大学管理层两周时间无条件撤销开除决定，恢复学生的学籍，允许他们完全使用大学设施、学生特权，并归还他们的学生证。“做出特别安排，使受影响的学生能够参加他们被禁止参加的考试。支付2亿奈拉（两亿奈拉）作为公开羞辱、诽谤、尴尬和心理创伤的损害赔偿，”被开除的学生要求。该大学的发言人Abdullahi Bello无法通过其已知电话号码联系到，就这一事态发展发表评论。9月16日，联邦大学杜策在其内部公告中公布了七名学生的姓名和照片，宣布对他们进行开除。他们被指控的罪行包括刑事共谋、持械抢劫、邪教活动、滥用药物、网络欺凌和企图性侵犯。根据该公布，有12名学生被开除，另外5名学生被停学。它说，这些决定是在第20届学生纪律委员会上批准的。它说，Emmanuel Anenechukwu、Ayomide Peter、Idris Ismail、Miracle Pelumi、Yazi Saleh和Yusuf Abdurrazak因刑事共谋和持械抢劫被开除。此外，Mubarak Usman和Divine Inuwa因抢劫和与邪教有关的活动指控被开除，而Ahmed Bashir因手机盗窃指控被开除。此外，校园内的滥用药物指控导致Ismail Muhammad、Aisha Yakubu和Fatima Muhammad被开除。另外五名学生因涉嫌与网络欺凌和企图性侵犯有关的罪行被停学。其中四人被停学两个学期，一人被停学一个学期

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/r.body: RMB Nigeria has been awarded M&A Deal of the Year 2025 by the Association of Issuing Houses of Nigeria (AIHN), recognising its role as exclusive financial adviser to Helios Investment Partners on the US$583 million acquisition of Axxela Limited. RMB Nigeria advised Helios on the landmark acquisition of Axxela, a leading energy infrastructure company in West Africa, by BlueCore Gas InfraCo Limited. The transaction involved Helios Investment Partners’ divestment of its 75 per cent equity interest in Axxela and Sojitz Corporation’s sale of its remaining 25 per cent stake through the exercise of its tag-along rights, resulting in the transfer of full ownership to BlueCore. As one of the significant private equity exits in Nigeria’s midstream energy sector in recent years, the transaction highlights the role of strategic capital and investor participation in supporting the development of critical energy infrastructure. Commenting on the recognition, Chief Executive Officer of RMB Nigeria, Bayo Ajayi, said: “Transactions of this scale demonstrate the value of sophisticated financial advice, deep market understanding and disciplined execution in bringing strategic opportunities to fruition. This RMB Nigeria continues to support corporate and institutional clients across Africa with financial advisory, funding and investment banking solutions. Mr Asafo-Adjei Ayeh said the records should have enabled the committee to match each beneficiary across both payment lists. “If we put together the numbers, we should be able to tell that Akosua signed the GH¢5,000 document, and the same Akosua is signing the GH¢500 document. https://www.myjoyonline.com/missing-sign.body_zh: 博索梅-弗雷霍议员兼议会外交事务委员会副首席成员纳纳·阿萨福-阿杰伊·阿耶表示，缺失的签名和支付记录中的差异是新爱国党对加纳人撤离支出中1640万塞地担忧的基础。阿萨福-阿杰伊·阿耶先生质疑了归因于非常年幼儿童的签名条目，包括一名一岁儿童和一名六个月大的婴儿。“当我们把数字汇总在一起时，我们发现了442名男性，我们看到一岁儿童、六个月大婴儿之前的签名。一岁儿童如何能够签署签名？这些是我们将数字汇总并得出我们的1640万的主要问题，”他说。这些担忧构成了少数党核心小组呼吁对政府4972万塞地撤离行动进行独立审计的一部分，他们声称外交部提供的记录留下超过1640万塞地需要进一步解释。他说这些差异告知了新爱国党用来得出其1640万塞地缺口主张的数字。博索梅-弗雷霍议员表示，为支付款项提供的文件没有充分核对据称支付给每名撤离者的5000塞地重返社会一揽子计划和500塞地交通补贴。阿萨福-阿杰伊·阿耶先生表示，这些记录本应使委员会能够将每名受益人在两个支付清单中进行匹配。“如果我们把数字汇总在一起，我们应该能够说明阿科苏阿签署了5000塞地文件，并且同一个阿科苏阿正在签署500塞地文件。只有这样才存在核对，”他说。他解释说，预期是两个清单都包含对应于据称已支付两种补贴的1964名个人的签名。然而，他说对记录的比较揭示了差异，包括文件上出现的签名数量的差异

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: Nigerian conservationist Edem Eniang has emerged as the West Africa regional chair of the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Snake Specialist Group, placing him in a regional leadership role in efforts to strengthen snake conservation and coordinate research across the sub-region. His emergence comes as the group works to establish its regional structures, membership lists and specialist working groups, alongside a revised process for admitting members. In a message of appointment shared with PREMIUM TIMES by Mr Eniang, the organisation said they had gained momentum following recent engagements at a meeting of the Wildlife Conservation Society , with encouraging responses during and after the conference. PREMIUM TIMES reported that Mr Eniang a professor and executive director of the Biodiversity Preservation Centr e, Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, was Nigeria’s only representative at the first World Congress on Snakes held from 1 to 4 October in Sri Lanka. The organisation said it was developing documents and strategies, including terms of reference for regional chairs, membership lists, working groups and a clearer organisational structure. The proposed arrangements are intended to improve coordination among regional teams, exchange ideas and reduce duplication of conservation activities. The proposed coordination framework would include online meetings of regional chairs three times a year, with separate quarterly meetings between each regional chair and members in their respective regions. IUCN stated that the meetings would help specialists share updates on the group’s priorities and exchange ideas without duplicating ongoing work. They also proposed holding a brief introductory meeting for regional chairs before the end of 2026. The IUCN Snake Specialist Group is part of the IUCN Species Survival Commission, a global network of experts that provides scientific advice on species conservation and supports efforts to address threats to wildlife. According to the group’s official website , its work covers knowledge of snake populations, conservation planning, analysis of threats, policy guidance and public education aimed at reducing conflict between people and snakes. The group focuses on thousands of snake species worldwide, although some groups, including vipers and sea snakes in the subfamily Hydrophiinae, fall under separate specialist groups. Mr Eniang’s appointment gives Nigeria representation in the group’s emerging regional leadership structure at a time when coordination among researchers and conservation practitioners is being strengthened. Other regional chairs listed in the message include Tim Colston and Adriaan Jordaan for East and Southern Africa; Chifundera Kusamba for Central Africa; Steven Allain for Europe; Evan Quah and Justin Bernstein for East and South-East Asia; and Melissa Bruton for Australia, Oceania and Melanesia. The message also listed regional representatives for South Asia, North America, Central America and the Caribbean. The group said it would circulate further information on its organisational arrangements and membership once the relevant documents and strategies were ready

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 尼日利亚自然保护主义者埃德姆·埃尼昂已当选为国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）蛇类专家组西非区域主席，使他在加强蛇类保护和协调该次区域研究努力方面担任区域领导角色。他的当选正值该小组致力于建立其区域结构、成员名单和专家工作组，以及修订成员接纳流程之际。在埃尼昂先生与PREMIUM TIMES分享的任命消息中，该组织表示，在最近参加野生动物保护协会会议后，他们获得了势头，并在会议期间和之后获得了积极回应。PREMIUM TIMES报道称，埃尼昂先生作为教授和乌约生物多样性保护中心执行主任，来自阿夸伊博姆州，是尼日利亚唯一代表，参加了10月1日至4日在斯里兰卡举行的首届世界蛇类大会。该组织表示，它正在制定文件和战略，包括区域主席的职权范围、成员名单、工作组以及更清晰的组织结构。拟议的安排旨在改善区域团队之间的协调、交流想法并减少保护活动的重复。拟议的协调框架将包括区域主席每年举行三次在线会议，以及每个区域主席与其各自区域成员之间单独的季度会议。IUCN表示，这些会议将帮助专家分享关于小组优先事项的更新并交流想法，而不会重复正在进行的工作。他们还提议在2026年底前为区域主席举行一次简短的介绍会议。IUCN蛇类专家组是IUCN物种生存委员会的一部分，这是一个全球专家网络，提供关于物种保护的科学建议，并支持应对野生动物威胁的努力。根据该小组官方网站，其工作涵盖蛇类种群知识、保护规划、威胁分析、政策指导以及旨在减少人与蛇之间冲突的公众教育。该小组专注于全球数千种蛇类，尽管某些类群，包括蝰蛇和Hydrophiinae亚科的海蛇，属于单独的专家组。埃尼昂先生的任命使尼日利亚在该小组新兴区域领导结构中获得代表权，此时研究人员和保护从业者之间的协调正在加强。消息中列出的其他区域主席包括东非和南部非洲的蒂姆·科尔斯顿和阿德里安·乔丹；中非的奇丰德拉·库桑巴；欧洲的史蒂文·阿拉因；东亚和东南亚的埃文·夸和贾斯廷·伯恩斯坦；以及澳大利亚、大洋洲和美拉尼西亚的梅丽莎·布鲁顿。该消息还列出了南亚、北美、中美洲和加勒比地区的区域代表。该小组表示，一旦相关文件和战略准备就绪，它将进一步传播关于其组织安排和成员资格的信息。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The FCT Minister, Nyesom Wike, members of the Rivers State House of Assembly, and the 23 local government chairpersons in Rivers State met with Governor Siminalayi Fubara at his private residence in Port Harcourt on Sunday. The meeting comes about a fortnight after Mr Wike led members of the Rainbow Coalition in Rivers, including Kingsley Chinda, the 2027 Rivers APC governorship candidate, to meet with the governor. Although details of Sunday’s meeting were not made public, Punch newspaper reported that it was part of efforts to accommodate Mr Fubara’s camp in the emerging political structure in the state ahead of the 2027 elections. The meeting is significant because Mr Wike and the state lawmakers had been at loggerheads with Mr Fubara amid a prolonged political crisis that disrupted governance in the oil-rich state. Mr Wike, a former governor of Rivers, has intensified political engagements across the state ahead of the 2027 elections. He has held rallies and visited traditional rulers to consolidate support for President Bola Tinubu and the APC. The minister has repeatedly vowed to deliver victories for Mr Tinubu in Rivers and the FCT. The renewed reconciliation efforts come as political alignments ahead of the 2027 elections gather momentum, with former Rivers governor Rotimi Amaechi emerging as the African Democratic Congress’s vice-presidential candidate. Although some of Mr Fubara’s supporters appear reluctant to embrace the reconciliation efforts, Sunday’s meeting could signal a further attempt to bring the governor’s camp into the emerging political arrangement. However, it remains unclear how much influence Mr Fubara and his loyalists would have in the proposed arrangement. The meeting comes against the backdrop of a protracted power struggle between Mr Fubara and Mr Wike, which extended to the state legislature and local government administration. The crisis escalated in March 2025 when President Tinubu declared a state of emergency in Rivers, suspended Mr Fubara and his deputy, Ngozi Odu, as well as the state House of Assembly, and appointed a retired naval chief, Ibok-Ete Ibas, as sole administrator. During the emergency rule, Mr Ibas dissolved boards and parastatals constituted under Mr Fubara’s administration and appointed new officials, many of whom were described as loyal to Mr Wike. His administration also conducted local government elections in which Mr Wike-aligned candidates emerged as chairpersons in the state’s 23 local government areas. The emergency rule was lifted in September 2025, paving the way for Mr Fubara and other suspended elected officials to return to office. Despite the governor’s return, tensions over political control and the state government’s composition have continued to shape relations between the two camps. Mr Fubara’s cabinet remains incomplete, and he has yet to submit additional nominees to the state assembly for screening, leaving key ministries such as information without a commissioner. The reported reconciliation effort is expected to test whether the governor’s loyalists can secure a place in the state’s evolving political structure ahead of the next general elections. However, neither the details of the discussions nor the terms of any proposed political arrangement were disclosed. For now, it remains unclear whether the meeting will bring a lasting resolution to the rivalry or mark another phase in negotiations over political control in Rivers State
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 联邦首都区部长奈耶索姆·威克、河流州议会成员以及河流州23个地方政府主席于周日在哈科特港的私人住所与州长西米纳拉伊·富巴拉会面。此次会晤发生在威克先生率领河流州彩虹联盟成员（包括2027年河流州APC州长候选人金斯利·钦达）与州长会面大约两周之后。虽然周日会晤的细节未向公众公布，但《Punch》报纸报道称，这是为了在2027年选举前将富巴拉先生阵营纳入该州正在形成的政治结构所做努力的一部分。此次会晤意义重大，因为威克先生和州议员们曾与富巴拉先生长期对立，此前一场旷日持久的政治危机扰乱了这个石油富庶州的治理。威克先生作为河流州前州长，在2027年选举前加强了在全州范围内的政治接触。他举行了集会并访问传统统治者，以巩固对博拉·蒂努布总统和APC的支持。该部长多次发誓要在河流州和联邦首都区为蒂努布先生带来胜利。重新开始的和解努力正值2027年选举前的政治结盟势头增强之际，前河流州州长罗蒂米·阿马埃奇已作为非洲民主大会党的副总统候选人出现。尽管富巴拉先生的一些支持者似乎不愿接受和解努力，但周日的会晤可能标志着进一步尝试将州长阵营纳入正在形成的政治安排。然而，目前尚不清楚富巴拉先生及其忠诚者在拟议安排中将拥有多大影响力。此次会晤发生在富巴拉先生与威克先生之间长期权力斗争的背景下，这一斗争已延伸至州立法机构和地方政府管理。危机在2025年3月升级，当时蒂努布总统宣布河流州进入紧急状态，暂停富巴拉先生及其副手恩戈齐·奥杜以及州议会的职务，并任命退役海军将领伊博克-埃特·伊巴斯为唯一行政长官。在紧急统治期间，伊巴斯先生解散了富巴拉先生政府下设立的董事会和半官方机构，并任命了新官员，其中许多人被描述为忠于威克先生。他的政府还举行了地方政府选举，威克先生阵营的候选人在该州23个地方政府区当选为主席。紧急统治于2025年9月解除，为富巴拉先生和其他被暂停的民选官员返回办公室铺平了道路。尽管州长已返回，但围绕政治控制和州政府组成的紧张关系继续影响着两个阵营之间的关系。富巴拉先生的内阁仍不完整，他尚未向州议会提交额外提名人选进行审查，导致信息等关键部委没有专员。据报道的和解努力预计将考验州长的忠诚者是否能在下届大选前在该州不断演变的政治结构中获得一席之地。然而，讨论的细节或任何拟议政治安排的条款均未披露。目前尚不清楚此次会晤是否会为竞争带来持久解决，或标志着河流州政治控制谈判的又一阶段。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/au-commissio.body: African Union Commissioner for Economic Development, Trade, Tourism, Industry and Minerals, Francisca Tatchououp Belobe, has pointed to Ghana’s Gold Board (GoldBod) as an example of how reforms in the mineral sector can help African countries strengthen foreign exchange reserves, support currency stability and build more resilient economies. She said the establishment of GoldBod showed how reforms in the mineral sector could support wider national development objectives, particularly through better foreign exchange management and stronger international reserves. She made the remarks at the Mining in Motion Conference on Monday, 19 October, where she said Ghana’s efforts to promote local content, strengthen domestic businesses and add value to its mineral resources offered valuable lessons for other African countries. She praised President John Dramani Mahama for Ghana’s approach and said the African Union was keen to share lessons from the initiative with other countries across the continent. According to her, Ghana’s GoldBod initiative showed how reforms in the mineral sector could contribute to broader economic objectives rather than focusing solely on the extraction and sale of natural resources. “The establishment of the Ghana Gold Board illustrates how mineral sector reform can serve broader national development objectives by improving foreign exchange, strengthening international reserves and supporting currency stability as well as macroeconomic resilience. The efforts to strengthen local content, domestic enterprises and mineral value addition also provide important lessons for other African countries,” she said. GoldBod recorded US$1.871 billion in foreign exchange from its artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) gold trading activities in September 2026, exceeding its monthly target of US$1.4 billion. In a release on Wednesday, September 30, the board said the foreign exchange generated had been channelled through authorised commercial banks and the Bank of Ghana to support stability in the foreign exchange market and strengthen the country’s reserves. She noted that retaining more value from mineral resources, strengthening local enterprises and improving the management of foreign exchange could help countries build stronger economic foundations
https://www.myjoyonline.com/au-commissio.title_zh: 非盟专员将GoldBod视为非洲矿业部门改革的典范
https://www.myjoyonline.com/au-commissio.body_zh: 非洲联盟经济开发、贸易、旅游、工业和矿产事务专员弗朗西斯卡·塔丘普·贝洛贝指出，加纳黄金局（GoldBod）是矿产部门改革如何帮助非洲国家加强外汇储备、支持货币稳定并构建更具韧性经济的一个例子。她说，黄金局的设立表明矿产部门改革如何能够支持更广泛的国家发展目标，特别是通过更好的外汇管理和更强大的国际储备。她是在10月19日星期一举行的‘Mining in Motion Conference’上发表上述言论的，她说加纳努力促进本地内容、加强国内企业和为其矿产资源增加价值，为其他非洲国家提供了宝贵经验。她赞扬约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马总统对加纳采取的方法，并表示非洲联盟渴望与非洲大陆其他国家分享这一举措的经验。根据她的说法，加纳的黄金局举措表明矿产部门改革如何能够为更广泛的经济目标做出贡献，而不仅仅是专注于自然资源的开采和销售。“加纳黄金局的设立表明，矿产部门改革如何能够通过改善外汇、加强国际储备、支持货币稳定以及宏观经济韧性来服务于更广泛的国家发展目标。加强本地内容、国内企业和矿产价值增加的努力也为其他非洲国家提供了重要经验，”她说。黄金局在2026年9月的个体和小型采矿（ASM）黄金交易活动中录得18.71亿美元的外汇，超过了其每月14亿美元的目标。在9月30日星期三的一份声明中，该局表示所产生的外汇已通过授权的商业银行和加纳银行引导，以支持外汇市场的稳定并加强该国的储备。她指出，从矿产资源中保留更多价值、加强本地企业和改善外汇管理可以帮助各国建立更强大的经济基础

https://www.myjoyonline.com/vice-preside.title: Vice-President calls for Chinese investment in local processing of Ghana’s raw materials
https://www.myjoyonline.com/vice-preside.summary: Vice-President Professor Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has urged Chinese investors to invest in Ghana’s local processing and manufacturing industries as part of efforts to accelerate industrialisation, create jobs and derive greater economic value from the country’s natural resources.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/vice-preside.summary_zh: 副总统纳安娜·简·奥波库-阿吉曼教授敦促中国投资者投资加纳本地加工和制造业，以此作为加速工业化、创造就业机会并从国家自然资源中获得更大经济价值的努力的一部分。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/vice-preside.body: Vice-President Professor Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has urged Chinese investors to invest in Ghana’s local processing and manufacturing industries as part of efforts to accelerate industrialisation, create jobs and derive greater economic value from the country’s natural resources. Speaking to Chinese business executives in Shanghai, she outlined investment opportunities in cocoa, shea nuts, cashew nuts, coconut, timber and other raw materials, encouraging investors to support the production of finished and semi-finished goods from these commodities. She emphasised that Ghana needed to reduce its reliance on raw material exports by building a strong manufacturing sector that could generate employment, enhance productivity and retain a greater proportion of economic value within the country. Professor Opoku-Agyemang pointed to timber processing as an area with significant potential, explaining that Ghana could secure better returns by producing furniture and other finished wood products instead of exporting logs. She said greater investment in domestic processing would strengthen industrial development while providing sustainable employment opportunities for the country’s growing population. The Vice-President further highlighted the importance of ensuring that technical and vocational education and training meets the needs of industry, enabling young people to acquire skills that correspond with available employment opportunities. “Training people for jobs that do not exist is training them for unemployment,” she said. She explained that investment in productive sectors was necessary to create opportunities for technically trained young people to put their skills to use and contribute to national development. She cautioned that a lack of adequate employment opportunities could leave increasing numbers of trained young people frustrated. Professor Opoku-Agyemang reiterated Ghana’s willingness to work with Chinese businesses through mutually beneficial partnerships, particularly in manufacturing, logistics and other productive areas that could contribute to sustainable economic growth. She also drew attention to the opportunities available through the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), which provides a framework for increasing trade across Africa. According to her, Ghana’s strategic location as a gateway to the wider African market presents an opportunity for Chinese investors to establish businesses that can reach customers across the continent. She nevertheless stressed that partnerships between Ghana and China should produce practical benefits for both countries, including employment creation, increased productive capacity and improved opportunities for Ghanaian businesses. The Vice-President also questioned the extent of Ghanaian traders’ participation in businesses associated with China, raising concerns about the opportunities available to them in the Chinese market. In particular, she questioned whether Ghanaian traders could obtain ownership stakes in the businesses they support. Her concerns highlighted the need for stronger participation by Ghanaian entrepreneurs in international trade and investment, ensuring that economic cooperation between the two countries provides opportunities for local businesses to benefit more directly. The discussions form part of Ghana’s wider efforts to strengthen economic relations with China and attract investment into industries capable of adding value to the country’s raw materials. Ghana produces commodities including cocoa, cashew nuts, shea and timber, alongside mineral resources such as bauxite, lithium and diamonds. Increasing investment in domestic processing and manufacturing could help create employment, develop local industries, reduce dependence on raw material exports and ensure that a larger share of the value generated from these resources remains in Ghana.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/vice-preside.title_zh: 副总统呼吁中国投资加纳原材料的本地加工
https://www.myjoyonline.com/vice-preside.body_zh: 副总统纳安娜·简·奥波库-阿吉曼教授敦促中国投资者投资加纳本地加工和制造业，以此作为加速工业化、创造就业机会并从国家自然资源中获取更大经济价值的努力的一部分。她在上海对中国企业高管讲话时，概述了可可、乳木果、腰果、椰子、木材和其他原材料的投资机会，鼓励投资者支持用这些商品生产成品和半成品。她强调，加纳需要通过建立强大的制造业来减少对原材料出口的依赖，该制造业能够创造就业、提高生产力并在国内保留更大比例的经济价值。奥波库-阿吉曼教授指出木材加工是一个具有巨大潜力的领域，她解释说，加纳可以通过生产家具和其他成品木制品而不是出口原木来获得更好的回报。她表示，对国内加工的更大投资将加强工业发展，同时为国家不断增长的人口提供可持续的就业机会。副总统进一步强调，确保技术和职业教育与培训满足行业需求的重要性，这能让年轻人获得与现有就业机会相匹配的技能。“为不存在的工作培训人们就是培训他们失业，”她说。她解释说，对生产性部门的投资对于为受过技术培训的年轻人创造机会来运用他们的技能并为国家发展做出贡献是必要的。她警告说，缺乏足够的就业机会可能会让越来越多受过培训的年轻人感到沮丧。奥波库-阿吉曼教授重申了加纳愿意通过互利伙伴关系与中国企业合作，特别是在制造业、物流和其他能够促进可持续经济增长的生产性领域。她还提请注意通过非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）提供的机会，该自贸区为增加非洲内部贸易提供了框架。据她介绍，加纳作为通往更广阔非洲市场的门户的战略位置为中国投资者提供了一个机会，可以建立能够触及整个非洲大陆客户的企业。尽管如此，她强调，加纳和中国之间的伙伴关系应该为两国带来实际利益，包括创造就业、提高生产能力和改善加纳企业的机会。副总统还质疑加纳贸易商参与与中国相关业务的程度，对他们在中国的市场中可获得的机会表示担忧。她特别质疑加纳贸易商是否能够获得他们所支持企业的所有权股份。她的担忧突显了加纳企业家需要更强地参与国际贸易和投资，确保两国之间的经济合作能为本地企业提供更直接的受益机会。这些讨论是加纳加强与中国经济关系并吸引投资进入能够为国家原材料增加价值的产业的更广泛努力的一部分。加纳生产包括可可、腰果、乳木果和木材在内的商品，以及铝土矿、锂和钻石等矿产资源。增加对国内加工和制造业的投资可以帮助创造就业、发展本地产业、减少对原材料出口的依赖，并确保这些资源产生的更大份额的价值留在加纳。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: Eight members of the Zamfara State House of Assembly who recently resigned from the All Progressives Congress (APC) have announced their return to the party. This development followed a meeting with President Bola Tinubu at the Presidential Villa in Abuja. The legislators were led to the meeting by the Minister of State for Defence, Bello Matawalle, alongside Aminu Jaji, who represents the Kaura Namoda/Birnin Magaji Federal Constituency in the House of Representatives. The lawmakers are Aliyu Kagara (Talata Mafara South), Ibrahim Tukur (Bakura), Faruk Dosara (Maradun I), Bashir Masama (Bukkuyum North), Muktaru Kaura (Kaura North), Nasiru Abdullahi (Maru North), Bashar Bello (Bungudu West), and Bashar Aliyu (Gummi I). They had been widely tipped to defect to the African Democratic Congress (ADC) after announcing their resignation from the APC, citing internal party friction and escalating security challenges in rural Zamfara communities. They also alleged non-payment of certain allowances and entitlements by the assembly. The lawmakers had been embroiled in a protracted power struggle in the State House of Assembly. They were suspended by the Assembly leadership for attempting to remove the Speaker. However, they have now stated that their grievances were being addressed through presidential reconciliation championed by Mr Matawalle. The lawmakers promised to work for the growth of the party and its victory in the 2027 elections. However, one of them, Mr Abdullahi (Maru North), has been screened to contest for the state legislature seat under the ADC. Zamfara is one of Nigeria’s most politically volatile states, currently governed by Dauda Lawal, who defected earlier this year from the PDP, having defeated the sitting APC governor, Mr Matawalle, in the 2023 governorship election. The state APC hierarchy has experienced persistent factional tensions among key party figures, including former governors Mr Matawalle and Abdul’aziz Yari, as well as federal lawmakers like Mr Jaji. President Tinubu’s intervention is seen by political analysts as a critical move to unite the party for the 2027 elections
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 2027年：八名赞法拉州议员转变立场，在会见蒂努布后准备重返APC
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 最近从全体进步大会党（APC）辞职的赞法拉州议会八名议员宣布重返该党。这一事态发展是在阿布贾总统别墅与总统博拉·蒂努布会面后发生的。这些议员由国防国务部长贝洛·马塔瓦莱率领，与代表众议院考拉·纳莫达/比尔宁·马加吉联邦选区的阿米努·贾吉一同参加会议。议员包括阿里尤·卡加拉（塔拉塔·马法拉南）、易卜拉欣·图库尔（巴库拉）、法鲁克·多萨拉（马拉敦一）、巴希尔·马萨马（布库尤姆北）、穆克塔鲁·考拉（考拉北）、纳西鲁·阿卜杜拉希（马鲁北）、巴沙尔·贝洛（本古杜西）和巴沙尔·阿里尤（古米一）。他们在宣布从APC辞职后，曾被广泛认为将转投非洲民主大会党（ADC），理由是党内摩擦以及赞法拉农村社区安全挑战升级。他们还指控议会未支付某些津贴和应享权利。这些议员曾卷入州议会旷日持久的权力斗争。他们因试图罢免议长而被议会领导层停职。然而，他们现在表示，他们的不满正通过马塔瓦莱先生推动的总统和解得到解决。这些议员承诺为该党的发展和在2027年选举中的胜利而努力。不过，其中一位阿卜杜拉希先生（马鲁北）已接受筛查，将以ADC身份竞选州议会席位。赞法拉是尼日利亚政治最动荡的州之一，目前由达乌达·拉瓦尔执政，他今年早些时候从人民民主党（PDP）转党，在2023年州长选举中击败了时任APC州长马塔瓦莱先生。该州APC领导层在包括前州长马塔瓦莱先生和阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里以及联邦议员如贾吉先生等关键党派人物之间一直存在持续的派系紧张。政治分析人士认为，蒂努布总统的干预是团结该党以备2027年选举的关键举措。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.summary: Kwara State Governor AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq has said the All Progressives Congress (APC) enjoys broad support in the state ahead of the 2027 general elections, citing Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) Nyesom Wike’s backing for President Bola Tinubu. He argued that Mr Wike’s support for Mr Tinubu could further strengthen the APC’s electoral position. Mr Wike’s support for Mr Tinubu has persisted despite his disagreements with some APC governors, including Mr AbdulRazaq.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.summary_zh: 夸拉州州长阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿卜杜勒拉扎克表示，在2027年大选之前，全进步大会党（APC）在该州享有广泛支持，他引用了联邦首都区（FCT）部长奈索姆·威克对总统博拉·蒂努布的支持。他认为威克先生对蒂努布先生的支持可能进一步加强APC的选举地位。尽管威克先生与包括阿卜杜勒拉扎克先生在内的一些APC州长存在分歧，但他对蒂努布先生的支持一直持续。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body: Kwara State Governor AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq has said the All Progressives Congress (APC) enjoys broad support in the state ahead of the 2027 general elections, citing Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) Nyesom Wike’s backing for President Bola Tinubu. Mr AbdulRazaq made the statement on Sunday in Ilorin while receiving a delegation of the APC Presidential Campaign Council (PCC), led by its Director-General, Abdulaziz Yari. The governor dismissed the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) as a weakened political force in Kwara. He argued that Mr Wike’s support for Mr Tinubu could further strengthen the APC’s electoral position. “The balance of the equation here is 70-30: 70 per cent APC and 30 per cent PDP. And that’s consistent from 2019 until the election. Nothing has changed except that the PDP has continued to weaken,” Mr AbdulRazaq said. He added that Mr Wike’s position could change the political calculations ahead of the elections. “With the national leader of the PDP being a member of our campaign council and declaring that his party, the PDP, will vote for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, it means that the PDP 30 per cent versus our 70 per cent is now adding up to 100 per cent,” he said. The governor’s projection was not accompanied by independent polling data to substantiate the claimed support percentages. Mr Wike’s support for Mr Tinubu has persisted despite his disagreements with some APC governors, including Mr AbdulRazaq. During a media chat in Port Harcourt on 2 September, the minister accused the Kwara governor of leading a campaign against him and said he had confronted him over the alleged hostility. The disagreement is linked to Mr Wike’s relationships with aggrieved APC figures in Kwara, some of whom oppose the governor’s preferred candidates ahead of the 2027 elections. The Wike-led PDP’s governorship candidate, Suleiman Kawu, is supported by some of the aggrieved APC figures, including sitting Kwara Central District senator, Salihu Mustapha, who is seeking reelection as the PDP candidate. Mr AbdulRazaq expressed confidence in the APC’s Kwara governorship candidate, Salihu Yakubu Danladi, the Speaker of the state House of Assembly, saying his legislative experience had given him an understanding of the state’s budget and government operations. The governor defended his administration’s record since the APC took office in 2019, citing developments in education, healthcare and the civil service. “When we came in 2019, it was a challenging situation. Salaries were not paid, gratuities were not paid, pensions were not paid. That is a thing of the past,” he said. Mr Yari said the delegation visited Kwara to seek the governor’s continued support for the APC’s nationwide campaign. The delegation included former governors Abdullahi Ganduje, Olusegun Mimiko, Ali Modu Sheriff, Rochas Okorocha, Aminu Bello Masari, Adamu Badaru, Ibrahim Shema, Sani Yerima, Danjuma Goje and Abubakar Aleiro, as well as APC National Secretary Ajibola Basiru. Former Speaker of the House of Representatives Dimeji Bankole and former lawmaker Olubunmi Ette were also among those present. The delegation, accompanied by Mr AbdulRazaq, later visited the Emir of Ilorin and Chairman of the Kwara State Council of Chiefs, Ibrahim Sulu-Gambari, at his palace to pay homage and seek prayers ahead of the 2027 elections. The visit comes amid internal disagreements within the Kwara APC over the party’s governorship ticket. PREMIUM TIMES earlier reported that a group identifying itself as the Kwara State APC Elders Caucus rejected Mr Danladi’s emergence as the party’s governorship candidate and urged the national leadership to revisit the outcome of the 22 May primary. The party dismissed the group’s position, insisting that the primary was validly conducted.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.title_zh: 2027年：阿卜杜勒拉扎克预测APC在夸拉州获胜，引用威克对蒂努布的支持
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body_zh: 夸拉州州长阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿卜杜勒拉扎克表示，在2027年大选之前，全进步大会党（APC）在该州享有广泛支持，并引用联邦首都区（FCT）部长奈耶索姆·维克对总统博拉·蒂努布的支持。阿卜杜勒拉扎克先生周日在伊洛林发表上述言论，当时他正在接待由其总干事阿卜杜拉齐兹·亚里领导的全进步大会党总统竞选委员会（PCC）代表团。州长认为人民民主党（PDP）在夸拉已是一支削弱的政治力量。他认为维克先生对蒂努布先生的支持可能进一步加强全进步大会党的选举地位。“这里的平衡方程式是70-30：70%属于全进步大会党，30%属于人民民主党。这从2019年一直到选举都是一致的。除了人民民主党继续削弱之外，没有任何变化，”阿卜杜勒拉扎克先生说。他补充说，维克先生的立场可能会改变选举前的政治计算。“随着人民民主党的全国领袖成为我们竞选委员会的成员，并宣布他的政党人民民主党将投票支持总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布，这意味着人民民主党的30%加上我们的70%现在总计达到100%，”他说。州长的预测并未附带独立民调数据来证实所声称的支持百分比。尽管维克先生与包括阿卜杜勒拉扎克先生在内的一些全进步大会党州长存在分歧，但他对蒂努布先生的支持一直持续。在9月2日哈科特港的一次媒体聊天中，该部长指责夸拉州州长领导了一场针对他的竞选活动，并表示他已就所谓的敌对行为与他当面对质。这一分歧与维克先生与夸拉州不满的全进步大会党人士的关系有关，其中一些人反对州长在2027年选举前偏好的候选人。由维克领导的人民民主党州长候选人苏莱曼·卡武得到一些不满的全进步大会党人士的支持，包括现任夸拉中央区参议员萨利胡·穆斯塔法，他正寻求作为人民民主党候选人连任。阿卜杜勒拉扎克先生对全进步大会党夸拉州州长候选人、州议会发言人萨利胡·雅库布·丹拉迪表示有信心，说他的立法经验使他了解了该州的预算和政府运作。州长为自全进步大会党2019年执政以来其政府的记录辩护，引用了教育、医疗和公务员系统的进展。“当我们2019年上任时，情况具有挑战性。工资没有支付，慰问金没有支付，养老金没有支付。那已成为过去，”他说。亚里先生表示，代表团访问夸拉是为了寻求州长继续支持全进步大会党在全国范围的竞选活动。代表团包括前州长阿卜杜拉希·甘杜杰、奥卢塞贡·米米科、阿里·莫杜·谢里夫、罗查斯·奥科罗查、阿米努·贝洛·马萨里、阿达穆·巴达鲁、易卜拉欣·谢马、萨尼·耶里马、丹朱马·戈杰和阿布巴卡尔·阿莱罗，以及全进步大会党全国书记阿吉博拉·巴西鲁。前众议院议长迪梅吉·班科莱和前议员奥卢本米·埃特也在出席者之列。代表团在阿卜杜勒拉扎克先生的陪同下，随后前往伊洛林埃米尔兼夸拉州酋长委员会主席易卜拉欣·苏鲁-甘巴里的宫殿致敬，并在2027年选举前寻求祈祷。此次访问是在夸拉全进步大会党内部就该党的州长候选人资格存在分歧之际进行的。PREMIUM TIMES此前报道称，一个自称为夸拉州全进步大会党长老核心小组的团体拒绝丹拉迪先生成为该党州长候选人的结果，并敦促全国领导层重新审议5月22日初选的结果。该党驳斥了该团体的立场，坚持认为初选是有效进行的。
