https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title: NLNG Dividends: Oyo govt challenges presidency to explain distribution of $3bn received under Tinubu
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary: The dispute followed Mr Makinde’s claim that each state was entitled to about N250 billion in NLNG dividends that had allegedly been withheld by the federal government. The presidency said NLNG had paid approximately $21.5 billion in dividends to the federation over the past 25 years, with less than $3 billion received under the Tinubu administration.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 争议源于马金德先生声称每个州有权获得约2500亿奈拉的NLNG分红，据称这些分红被联邦政府扣留。总统府表示，NLNG在过去25年中已向联邦支付约215亿美元的分红，其中在蒂努布政府领导下收到的不到30亿美元。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: In a statement issued by his Special Adviser on Media, Sulaimon Olanrewaju, Mr Makinde said the presidency’s response failed to address the central question of how the funds were distributed. The governor, the presidential candidate of the Allied People’s Movement for the 2027 election, said the Nigeria Governors’ Forum (NGF), with the federal government’s support, engaged a consultant to reconcile NLNG dividend payments. “The exercise identified a shortfall of about N9 trillion due to states and local governments. The federal government accepted the findings,” the statement read. Mr Makinde added that the reconciliation report remained in the custody of both the federal government and the NGF, expressing confidence that the presidency would not deny its existence. The governor, who will be running against President Tinubu, the candidate of the All Progressives Congress in the upcoming 2027 election, is the incumbent vice-chairman of the NGF. The dispute followed Mr Makinde’s claim that each state was entitled to about N250 billion in NLNG dividends that had allegedly been withheld by the federal government. In its response on Sunday, presidential spokesperson Bayo Onanuga described the claim as false, arguing that the amount would imply a total distribution of N9 trillion to the 36 states alone. Mr Onanuga said states receive 26.72 per cent of distributable Federation Account revenue under the existing revenue-sharing formula. He argued that for the states’ combined share to reach N9 trillion, total NLNG dividends paid into the Federation Account would have to exceed N33.68 trillion ($25 billion), in a single declaration. The presidency said NLNG had paid approximately $21.5 billion in dividends to the federation over the past 25 years, with less than $3 billion received under the Tinubu administration. The Oyo government said the presidency had not explained how the dividends received under the current administration were distributed or how much each tier of government received. “Have states and local governments received their shares? How much did they receive, and how were those amounts calculated? What happened to the $3 billion received under this administration?” the statement asked. The statement also defended Mr Makinde’s figures, saying the governor had a basis for his claims. “Governor Makinde conducts public discourse with decorum and does not make unfounded claims or quote figures without a basis.” It urged the presidency to address the substance of the allegation and said it was ready to provide further clarification

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 在他的媒体特别顾问苏莱曼·奥兰雷瓦朱发表的一份声明中，马金德先生表示，总统府的回应未能解决资金如何分配的核心问题。这位州长、2027年选举中人民联盟运动的总统候选人表示，尼日利亚州长论坛（NGF）在联邦政府的支持下，聘请了一名顾问来核对NLNG的股息支付。“该行动发现各州和地方政府存在约9万亿奈拉的短缺。联邦政府接受了这些调查结果，”声明写道。马金德先生补充说，和解报告仍由联邦政府和尼日利亚州长论坛共同保管，他表示相信总统府不会否认其存在。这位州长将在即将到来的2027年选举中与进步大会党候选人蒂努布总统竞争，他是尼日利亚州长论坛的现任副主席。这场争端源于马金德先生声称每个州有权获得约2500亿奈拉的NLNG股息，据称这些股息被联邦政府扣留。在周日的回应中，总统发言人巴约·奥纳努加称这一说法是虚假的，认为这一数额将意味着仅向36个州就总共分配9万亿奈拉。奥纳努加先生表示，根据现有的收入分享公式，各州获得可分配联邦账户收入的26.72%。他辩称，要使各州合计份额达到9万亿奈拉，支付到联邦账户的NLNG股息总额必须超过33.68万亿奈拉（250亿美元），这是在单次申报中的情况。总统府表示，NLNG在过去25年中已向联邦支付约215亿美元的股息，在蒂努布政府期间收到的不到30亿美元。奥约州政府表示，总统府没有解释当前政府期间收到的股息是如何分配的，或者各级政府各自收到了多少。“各州和地方政府是否收到了他们的份额？他们收到了多少，这些金额是如何计算的？本届政府收到的30亿美元发生了什么？”声明问道。该声明还为马金德先生的数字进行了辩护，称州长有依据提出他的主张。“马金德州长以礼貌的方式进行公共讨论，不会提出毫无根据的主张或在没有依据的情况下引用数字。”它敦促总统府回应指控的实质内容，并表示准备提供进一步澄清。

https://leadership.ng/federal-government.summary: The federal government, through the Bank of Industry (BOI) and the Federal Ministry of Youth Development (FMYD), has launched a pilot empowerment programme offering free vocational and entrepreneurial training to 500 young Nigerians. The BOI Youth Empowerment Pilot Programme, announced in Lagos will be delivered by Sapphital, a Pan-African digital learning and technology company based in Abuja.
https://leadership.ng/federal-government.summary_zh: 联邦政府通过工业银行（BOI）和联邦青年发展部（FMYD）启动了一项试点赋权计划，为500名尼日利亚青年提供免费职业和创业培训。该BOI青年赋权试点计划在拉各斯宣布，将由Sapphital交付，这是一家总部位于阿布贾的泛非数字学习和技术公司。
https://leadership.ng/federal-government.body: The federal government, through the Bank of Industry (BOI) and the Federal Ministry of Youth Development (FMYD), has launched a pilot empowerment programme offering free vocational and entrepreneurial training to 500 young Nigerians. The BOI Youth Empowerment Pilot Programme, announced in Lagos will be delivered by Sapphital, a Pan-African digital learning and technology company based in Abuja. Sapphital specialises in AI-powered Learning Management Systems (LMS), e-learning and custom software solutions. The training will be delivered through the Nigerian Youth Academy (NiYA), where participants will complete short, instructor-led video courses. The courses were carefully selected based on income-generation potential and market demand, covering creative and artisan skills, production and manufacturing skills, as well as digital skills. In addition to the core training, selected participants will have access to mentorship, practical exposure and enterprise support opportunities to help them transition into employment or entrepreneurship. Speaking on the launch, the Minister of Youth Development, Ayodele Olawande, reaffirmed the administration’s commitment to youth empowerment. “President Bola Tinubu believes that youth empowerment and training are core pillars of national reform. A nation succeeds when its young population are globally competitive. Through this programme, we hope to equip Nigerian youths with the skills and capabilities they need to compete and thrive on a global scale,” Olawande said. Speaking on the programme, the managing director and chief executive officer of the Bank of Industry, Dr. Olasupo Olusi described young Nigerians as the country’s greatest economic asset. “Young Nigerians are our greatest economic asset, and the Bank of Industry is committed to providing them the tools required to build a brighter future, creating viable enterprises. This pilot is much more than just a training programme. It connects young people to skills, mentorship and real opportunities to start and sustain businesses,” Olusi said. “Through our partnership with the Federal Ministry of Youth Development and Sapphital, we are building a model that can be scaled across Nigeria to reach even more young people in support of the Renewed Hope Agenda,” he added. https://leadership.ng/timi-frank-seeks-t.title: Timi Frank Seeks Trump’s Help Over Alleged Threat To Atiku’s Safety
https://leadership.ng/timi-frank-seeks-t.summary: Frank, in an open letter addressed to Trump and other international leaders on Monday, expressed concern over reports of alleged plans to intimidate, arrest, detain or otherwise undermine Atiku’s participation in the forthcoming electoral process.
https://leadership.ng/timi-frank-seeks-t.summary_zh: 弗兰克周一在一封致特朗普和其他国际领导人的公开信中，对有关据称计划恐吓、逮捕、拘留或以其他方式破坏阿蒂库参与即将到来的选举进程的报道表示担忧。
https://leadership.ng/timi-frank-seeks-t.body: Frank, in an open letter addressed to Trump and other international leaders on Monday, expressed concern over reports of alleged plans to intimidate, arrest, detain or otherwise undermine Atiku’s participation in the forthcoming electoral process. Atiku, a leading opposition figure and presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), has been at the centre of political debates ahead of the 2027 elections. Frank urged the United States, the United Nations, the African Union (AU), the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS), the European Union (EU) and the United Kingdom to engage the Nigerian government and demand credible assurances regarding the safety of opposition leaders. According to Frank, who serves as an ambassador of the United Liberation Movement for West Papua (ULMWP) to East Africa and the Middle East, the allegations concerning Atiku’s safety and the possible use of state institutions against opposition figures require urgent and independent investigation. “These allegations must be independently and urgently investigated. Given their gravity, however, they cannot be dismissed or ignored until it is too late to prevent harm,” he said. Frank warned that any attempt to use law enforcement or security agencies to obstruct opposition candidates would undermine democratic participation and erode public confidence in Nigeria’s institutions. “The protection of political opposition is not a favour that any government grants at its discretion. It is a fundamental obligation of every democratic state,” he said. He specifically raised concerns over allegations that the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) could be used to initiate proceedings against Atiku under circumstances that might lead to his arrest and prolonged detention during the election campaign. However, Frank clarified that his position was not that political figures should be exempt from legitimate investigations, but that law enforcement agencies must operate independently and without political interference. “The concern is not that Atiku Abubakar should be placed above the law. The concern is that the law must never be placed at the service of political persecution,” he said. He called on the Federal Government to ensure that any investigation involving opposition figures was based on credible evidence and conducted in accordance with due process. Frank also questioned the perceived selective application of anti-corruption laws, arguing that public confidence in institutions such as the EFCC depended on their ability to investigate allegations impartially, regardless of political affiliation. He maintained that no public official or political associate should be shielded from legitimate scrutiny because of proximity to the presidency. “If the government expects Nigerians to trust its anti-corruption institutions, those institutions must demonstrate that justice is neither partisan nor selective,” he said. Describing Atiku as one of Nigeria’s most prominent opposition figures, Frank said his criticism of government policies and participation in debates on governance and public accountability were legitimate features of a democratic system. He argued that political disagreements should be addressed through open debate and lawful procedures rather than intimidation or threats. “The test of Nigeria’s democracy is not whether the government protects its allies, but whether it protects the rights of those who challenge it,” Frank added. Frank also expressed concern about the credibility of the 2027 general elections, urging the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), security agencies and the judiciary to demonstrate impartiality in the discharge of their responsibilities. He said allegations of restrictions on opposition campaigns, political intimidation and interference with electoral institutions should be independently investigated before they escalate.
https://leadership.ng/timi-frank-seeks-t.title_zh: Timi Frank寻求特朗普帮助，称Atiku安全受到威胁
https://leadership.ng/timi-frank-seeks-t.body_zh: 弗兰克周一在一封致特朗普和其他国际领导人的公开信中，对有关据称计划恐吓、逮捕、拘留或以其他方式破坏阿蒂库参与即将到来的选举进程的报道表示担忧。阿蒂库作为主要反对派人物和非洲民主大会党（ADC）的总统候选人，在2027年选举前一直处于政治辩论的中心。弗兰克敦促美国、联合国、非洲联盟（AU）、西非国家经济共同体（ECOWAS）、欧洲联盟（EU）和联合王国与尼日利亚政府接触，并要求就反对派领导人的安全问题提供可信的保证。据作为西巴布亚联合解放运动（ULMWP）驻东非和中东大使的弗兰克称，有关阿蒂库安全以及可能利用国家机构对付反对派人物的指控需要进行紧急和独立的调查。“这些指控必须独立且紧急地进行调查。然而，鉴于其严重性，在为时已晚无法防止伤害之前，它们不能被驳回或忽视，”他说。弗兰克警告说，任何试图利用执法或安全机构阻挠反对派候选人的行为都将破坏民主参与并削弱公众对尼日利亚机构的信心。“保护政治反对派不是任何政府自行决定的恩惠。它是每个民主国家的一项基本义务，”他说。他特别对有关经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）可能被用来在可能导致阿蒂库在选举竞选期间被捕和长期拘留的情况下启动针对阿蒂库的程序的指控表示担忧。然而，弗兰克澄清说，他的立场并非政治人物应免于合法调查，而是执法机构必须独立运作且不受政治干预。“问题不是阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔应该凌驾于法律之上。问题是法律绝不能被置于为政治迫害服务的地位，”他说。他呼吁联邦政府确保任何涉及反对派人物的调查都基于可信证据并按照正当程序进行。弗兰克还质疑反腐败法律被认为的选择性适用，他认为公众对EFCC等机构的信心取决于它们无论政治派别如何都能公正调查指控的能力。他坚持认为，任何公职人员或政治伙伴都不应因与总统的关系而免于合法审查。“如果政府期望尼日利亚人信任其反腐败机构，这些机构必须证明正义既非党派也非选择性的，”他说。弗兰克将阿蒂库描述为尼日利亚最杰出的反对派人物之一，他说他对政府政策的批评以及参与关于治理和公共问责的辩论是民主制度的合法特征。他认为，政治分歧应通过公开辩论和合法程序来解决，而不是通过恐吓或威胁。“尼日利亚民主的考验不是政府是否保护其盟友，而是它是否保护那些挑战它的人的权利，”弗兰克补充说。弗兰克还对2027年大选的可信度表示担忧，敦促独立国家选举委员会（INEC）、安全机构和司法机构在履行职责时表现出公正性。他说，有关限制反对派竞选、政治恐吓和干预选举机构的指控应在升级之前进行独立调查。

https://leadership.ng/matawalle-leads-8-.summary: Eight suspended members of the Zamfara State House of Assembly who recently resigned from the All Progressives Congress (APC) have met with President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, reaffirming their loyalty to the party. The lawmakers were led to the Presidential Villa by the Minister of State for Defence and former Governor of Zamfara State, Dr. Bello Matawalle.
https://leadership.ng/matawalle-leads-8-.summary_zh: 最近从全体进步大会党（APC）辞职的赞法拉州议会八名被停职议员会见了博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统，重申他们对该党的忠诚。这些议员由国防部部长级官员兼赞法拉州前州长贝洛·马塔瓦莱博士带领前往总统官邸。
https://leadership.ng/matawalle-leads-8-.body: Eight suspended members of the Zamfara State House of Assembly who recently resigned from the All Progressives Congress (APC) have met with President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, reaffirming their loyalty to the party. The lawmakers were led to the Presidential Villa by the Minister of State for Defence and former Governor of Zamfara State, Dr. Bello Matawalle. A statement by Matawalle’s Personal Assistant on Media, Ahmad Dan-Wudil, on Monday said the lawmakers reaffirmed their support for President Tinubu and their resolve to remain in the APC. According to the statement, Matawalle pledged to integrate the lawmakers into the Tinubu Again Movement (TAM) to work collectively for President Tinubu and all APC candidates ahead of the 2027 general elections. The lawmakers are Aliyu Ango Kagara (Talata Mafara South), Ibrahim Tukur Bakura (Bakura), Faruk Musa Dosara (Maradun I), Bashir Abubakar Masama (Bukkuyum North), Muktaru Nasiru Kaura (Kaura North), Nasiru Abdullahi (Maru North), Bashar Bello (Bungudu West), and Bashar Aliyu (Gummi I). LEADERSHIP recalls that the eight lawmakers were suspended on February 26, 2024, over allegations of gross misconduct, conspiracy and holding an illegal sitting. The suspension was extended on May 13, 2026. The Speaker of the Zamfara State House of Assembly, Bilyaminu Ismail Moriki, had said the suspension predated their political decision and arose from disciplinary matters within the House. The lawmakers had in their resignation letters cited alleged injustice, disunity among APC stakeholders in the state and the handling of insecurity as reasons for leaving the party. An APC chieftain, Dr. Sani Shinkafi, had clarified that five of the eight legislators were elected in 2023 on the platform of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) before defecting to the APC, while only three won their seats on the APC ticket. https://leadership.ng/fg-targets-1m-cng-.title: FG Targets 1m CNG Vehicles To Reduce Transport Fares
https://leadership.ng/fg-targets-1m-cng-.summary: Ekpo said the government must ensure that its autogas policy delivers tangible benefits to Nigerians, particularly by reducing transport fares following the removal of the petrol subsidy in 2023. However, the extent to which it can reduce transport fares depends on the availability of refuelling stations, affordable vehicle conversions, reliable gas supply and whether operators pass their fuel savings on to passengers.
https://leadership.ng/fg-targets-1m-cng-.summary_zh: 埃克波说，政府必须确保其汽车燃气政策为尼日利亚人带来切实利益，特别是在2023年取消汽油补贴后降低交通费用。然而，它能在多大程度上降低交通费用取决于加油站的可用性、负担得起的车辆改装、可靠的燃气供应以及运营商是否将他们的燃料节省传递给乘客。
https://leadership.ng/fg-targets-1m-cng-.body: The Minister of State for Petroleum Resources (Gas), Ekperikpe Ekpo, gave the directive in Abuja over the weekend while receiving progress reports from the Presidential Initiative on Compressed Natural Gas and Electric Vehicles and the Decade of Gas Secretariat. Ekpo said the government must ensure that its autogas policy delivers tangible benefits to Nigerians, particularly by reducing transport fares following the removal of the petrol subsidy in 2023. According to a statement issued on Sunday by the minister’s spokesman, Louis Ibah, Ekpo tasked the leadership of the two bodies with identifying critical interventions, expanding infrastructure and strengthening programmes to increase the nationwide adoption of CNG. The statement said the government would intensify efforts to promote CNG as a cheaper alternative fuel for transportation, with renewed emphasis on accelerating the deployment of one million gas-powered vehicles across the country. The renewed push comes amid persistent concerns over rising public transportation costs since the removal of the petrol subsidy, which increased fuel expenses for commercial transport operators and added pressure on household incomes. CNG has been promoted by the federal government as an alternative to petrol because it is generally cheaper on an energy-equivalent basis. However, the extent to which it can reduce transport fares depends on the availability of refuelling stations, affordable vehicle conversions, reliable gas supply and whether operators pass their fuel savings on to passengers. Ekpo said Nigeria’s abundant natural gas reserves presented an opportunity to reduce transportation costs, increase domestic gas consumption and stimulate economic growth. “Nigeria is a gas nation with a gas reserves index of over 80 yrs, and that is why we are talking about the Decade(s) of Gas,” he said. The minister stressed the need to implement President Bola Tinubu’s directive to make transportation more affordable through CNG, assuring officials of the government’s continued support. “It is important that we listen to the directive of Mr President to make transportation cheaper via CNG. We will continue to give you all the backing to provide the necessary assistance to make sure we drive this project to a logical conclusion,” Ekpo said. He urged the Presidential Initiative on CNG and Electric Vehicles and the Decade of Gas Secretariat to sustain investments in refuelling infrastructure, vehicle conversion facilities and other essential components required to expand the use of natural gas as a transportation fuel. Ekpo also welcomed progress recorded under the current leadership of the Presidential Initiative on CNG and Electric Vehicles, reiterating the government’s commitment to supporting the programme. He further disclosed that domestic gas consumption had risen above two billion cubic feet per day for the first time in Nigeria’s history, describing the development as an opportunity to deepen gas utilisation and advance the country’s economic ambitions. The chairman of the Presidential Initiative on CNG and Electric Vehicles, Ismaeel Ahmed, said the initiative would intensify investments and programmes to expand refuelling infrastructure and increase the number of vehicles converted to run on gas. Ahmed said the effort was designed to make CNG more accessible to transport operators and help reduce fares for millions of Nigerians. He added that a joint industry market study completed by the Decade of Gas Secretariat had provided a framework for accelerating the rollout, monitoring progress, identifying infrastructure gaps and improving implementation. According to him, the study would help the government and industry stakeholders determine priority interventions and strengthen efforts to make CNG widely available as a transportation fuel.
https://leadership.ng/fg-targets-1m-cng-.title_zh: 联邦政府目标实现100万辆压缩天然气汽车以降低交通费用
https://leadership.ng/fg-targets-1m-cng-.body_zh: 石油资源国务部长（天然气），埃克佩里克佩·埃克波，周末在阿布贾接收总统压缩天然气和电动汽车倡议以及天然气十年秘书处的进展报告时下达了这一指令。埃克波表示，政府必须确保其汽车燃气政策为尼日利亚人带来切实利益，特别是在2023年取消汽油补贴后通过降低交通费用来实现这一点。根据部长发言人路易斯·伊巴赫周日发布的声明，埃克波责成这两个机构的领导层确定关键干预措施、扩大基础设施并加强计划，以提高全国范围内对压缩天然气的采用。该声明称，政府将加大力度推广压缩天然气作为更廉价的交通替代燃料，并再次强调加快在全国部署100万辆燃气动力汽车。这一新的推动举措是在取消汽油补贴以来公众对公共交通成本持续上涨的担忧中提出的，这增加了商业运输运营商的燃料费用，并对家庭收入造成压力。联邦政府一直将压缩天然气作为汽油的替代品进行推广，因为它在能量等效基础上通常更便宜。然而，它能在多大程度上降低交通费用取决于加油站的可用性、负担得起的车辆改装、可靠的天然气供应以及运营商是否将燃料节省传递给乘客。埃克波表示，尼日利亚丰富的天然气储量提供了一个降低运输成本、增加国内天然气消耗并刺激经济增长的机会。“尼日利亚是一个天然气国家，天然气储量指数超过80年，这就是我们谈论天然气十年（或数十年）的原因，”他说。部长强调需要落实总统博拉·蒂努布通过压缩天然气使交通更负担得起的指令，并向官员们保证政府将继续提供支持。“重要的是我们要听取总统先生的指令，通过压缩天然气使交通更便宜。我们将继续给予你们所有支持，提供必要的援助，以确保我们将这个项目推进到合乎逻辑的结论，”埃克波说。他敦促总统压缩天然气和电动汽车倡议以及天然气十年秘书处持续投资于加油基础设施、车辆改装设施以及扩大天然气作为交通燃料使用的其他必要组成部分。埃克波还对总统压缩天然气和电动汽车倡议当前领导层下取得的进展表示欢迎，重申政府支持该计划的承诺。他进一步透露，国内天然气消耗量首次超过每天20亿立方英尺，称这一发展是一个深化天然气利用并推进国家经济雄心的机会。总统压缩天然气和电动汽车倡议主席伊斯梅尔·艾哈迈德表示，该倡议将加大投资和计划，以扩大加油基础设施并增加改装为燃气运行的车辆数量。艾哈迈德说，这一努力旨在使压缩天然气对运输运营商更易获取，并帮助降低数百万尼日利亚人的交通费用。他补充说，由天然气十年秘书处完成的一项联合行业市场研究为加速推广、监测进展、识别基础设施差距和改进实施提供了框架。据他介绍，该研究将帮助政府和行业利益相关者确定优先干预措施，并加强使压缩天然气作为交通燃料广泛可用的努力。

https://leadership.ng/presidency-denies-.summary: In a statement issued by the State House on Sunday, the Special Adviser to President Bola Tinubu on Information and Strategy, Bayo Onanuga, urged Nigerians to disregard the claim, arguing that the amount involved was inconsistent with NLNG’s historical dividend payments to the Federation. However, the Presidency rejected the allegation, insisting that the amount claimed could not be supported by the established revenue-sharing formula and NLNG’s dividend payment history.
https://leadership.ng/presidency-denies-.summary_zh: 周日由总统府发布的声明中，博拉·蒂努布总统的信息和战略特别顾问巴约·奥纳努加敦促尼日利亚人无视这一说法，认为所涉金额与尼日利亚液化天然气公司历史上向联邦支付的股息不一致。然而，总统府驳斥了这一指控，坚持认为所声称的金额无法得到既定收入分享公式和尼日利亚液化天然气公司股息支付历史的支撑。
https://leadership.ng/presidency-denies-.body: In a statement issued by the State House on Sunday, the Special Adviser to President Bola Tinubu on Information and Strategy, Bayo Onanuga, urged Nigerians to disregard the claim, arguing that the amount involved was inconsistent with NLNG’s historical dividend payments to the Federation. Makinde had made the allegation on Friday at the 2027 Budget Stakeholders’ Consultative Engagement held at the Olola Ogunlana Hall, International Conference Centre, University of Ibadan. The governor reportedly said the states were each entitled to ₦250 billion and that Oyo State had already identified projects that could expand its economy. He alleged that the funds would not be released until after the 2027 elections. “Each state was supposed to get ₦250 billion. We had already identified projects that would expand Oyo State’s economy. But they have now said the money will not be paid until after the election. Is the election more important than the people of Nigeria?” Makinde was quoted as saying. However, the Presidency rejected the allegation, insisting that the amount claimed could not be supported by the established revenue-sharing formula and NLNG’s dividend payment history. According to Onanuga, distributing ₦250 billion to each of the 36 states would amount to ₦9 trillion, excluding the federal government, the Federal Capital Territory and the 774 local government areas. The statement explained that, under the Federation Account Allocation Committee (FAAC) revenue-sharing formula, states receive 26.72 per cent of distributable Federation Account revenue. It argued that for the 36 states alone to receive a combined ₦9 trillion from NLNG dividends, the company would have to declare more than ₦33.68 trillion, equivalent to about $25 billion, in a single payout. The Presidency maintained that NLNG had never paid $25 billion in dividends to the Federation Account in a single declaration. “NLNG has paid approximately $21.5 billion in dividends to the Federation over the last 25 years, with less than $3 billion realised since President Bola Ahmed Tinubu assumed office,” the statement said. It added that the claim of a single dividend payment exceeding the company’s entire reported lifetime distribution to the Federation was inconsistent with the figures cited by the government. The Presidency also criticised Makinde’s public statements since he declared his presidential ambition, accusing him of making misleading claims. It recalled his previous description of the financial allocations states receive from the Federation Account, including Oyo State, as “voodoo.” While acknowledging the governor’s constitutional right to pursue his presidential ambition, the statement urged him to avoid making claims it described as false and misleading. “We urge the public to disregard these unfounded claims, which serve only to mislead citizens and stoke needless disaffection against the Federal authorities,” it said. In July, the company’s Chief Executive Officer, Adeleye Falade, said NLNG had paid $47.2 billion in dividends to all its shareholders, including the Federal Government, from revenue of $149.6 billion since it began operations. NLNG’s Facts and Figures report also showed that annual payments to the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited, its government shareholder, stood at $1.39 billion in 2014, $722.44 million in 2021 and $1.10 billion in 2022. Meanwhile, the 36 states reportedly received ₦4.83 trillion from the Federation Account between January and June, with Oyo State receiving ₦147.32 billion. Makinde declared his presidential ambition on May 14 at a rally in Ibadan under the APM, following the party’s alliance with a faction of the Peoples Democratic Party led by Kabiru Turaki. https://leadership.ng/presidency-denies-.title_zh: 总统府否认扣留每个州2500亿奈拉尼日利亚液化天然气公司股息
https://leadership.ng/presidency-denies-.body_zh: 周日，总统府发表声明，总统博拉·蒂努布的信息和战略特别顾问巴约·奥纳努加敦促尼日利亚人不要理会这一说法，认为所涉金额与NLNG历来支付给联邦的股息不符。马金德于周五在伊巴丹大学国际会议中心奥洛拉·奥贡拉纳大厅举行的2027年预算利益相关者协商会议上提出了这一指控。据报道，这位州长说，各州每州应得2500亿奈拉，奥约州已经确定了可以扩大其经济的项目。他声称这些资金要到2027年选举之后才会发放。“每个州本应得到2500亿奈拉。我们已经确定了将扩大奥约州经济的项目。但他们现在说这笔钱要到选举后才会支付。选举比尼日利亚人民更重要吗？”马金德被引述说。然而，总统府驳斥了这一指控，坚持认为所声称的金额无法得到既定收入分享公式和NLNG股息支付历史的支撑。根据奥纳努加的说法，向36个州中的每一个州分配2500亿奈拉将总计达到9万亿奈拉，这还不包括联邦政府、联邦首都区和774个地方政府。声明解释说，根据联邦账户分配委员会（FAAC）的收入分享公式，各州获得可分配联邦账户收入的26.72%。它认为，仅36个州就从NLNG股息中获得合计9万亿奈拉，该公司就必须一次性宣布超过33.68万亿奈拉，相当于约250亿美元。总统府坚持认为，NLNG从未在一次宣布中向联邦账户支付250亿美元的股息。“在过去25年中，NLNG已向联邦支付约215亿美元的股息，自博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统就职以来实现的不到30亿美元，”声明说。它补充说，单次股息支付超过该公司向联邦报告的整个生命周期分配总额的说法，与政府引用的数字不符。总统府还批评了马金德自宣布总统竞选抱负以来的公开声明，指责他提出误导性说法。它回顾了他此前将各州包括奥约州从联邦账户获得的财政拨款描述为“巫术”。声明在承认州长有宪法权利追求其总统竞选抱负的同时，敦促他避免提出被描述为虚假和误导性的说法。“我们敦促公众不要理会这些毫无根据的说法，这些说法只会误导公民并煽动对联邦当局不必要的不满，”声明说。今年7月，该公司首席执行官阿德莱耶·法拉德表示，NLNG已向包括联邦政府在内的所有股东支付了472亿美元的股息，这些股息来自自开始运营以来1496亿美元的收入。NLNG的《事实与数据》报告还显示，向其政府股东尼日利亚国家石油公司有限公司的年度付款在2014年为13.9亿美元，2021年为7.2244亿美元，2022年为11亿美元。与此同时，据报道，36个州在1月至6月期间从联邦账户获得了4.83万亿奈拉，其中奥约州获得了1473.2亿奈拉。马金德于5月14日在伊巴丹的一次集会上宣布了他的总统竞选抱负，该集会在APM下举行，此前该党与由卡比鲁·图拉基领导的人民民主党派系结盟。我们拥有优势。获取实时报道、突发独家新闻和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧的新闻。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/n.summary: This development is yet another strategic intervention, a development streak made possible and attracted to Bende Federal Constituency of Abia State by Rt. Benjamin Okezie Kalu, PhD, CFR, the Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives. So, when President Bola Ahmed Tinubu approved the National Universal Communications Access Programme, NUCAP, under the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, Kalu promptly positioned Bende for consideration.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/n.summary_zh: 这一发展又是另一项战略干预，是由众议院副议长、本杰明·奥凯齐·卡卢博士、CFR为阿比亚州本德联邦选区带来并吸引而来的一系列发展。因此，当总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布批准联邦通讯、创新和数字经济部下属的国家通用通讯接入计划（NUCAP）时，卡卢迅速将本德定位为考虑对象。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/n.body: For years, connectivity in Bende was not a given but a quest. To make or receive a telephone call, residents traversed a kilometre or two, moving from one location to another in search of a signal. Opportunities lost. Development stalled. Progress retarded. It felt like a throwback to the darker age of the 18th century. Excitedly, the protracted wait, worry and seeming disappointments came to an end on Friday, October 16, 2026 with the commissioning of a digital telecommunications tower along the Umuahia-Ohafia Road, Bende. With that singular mast installed, the long odyssey for reliable communication has been concluded. This development is yet another strategic intervention, a development streak made possible and attracted to Bende Federal Constituency of Abia State by Rt. Hon. Benjamin Okezie Kalu, PhD, CFR, the Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives. To those acquainted with his political trajectory, it is hardly surprising. Kalu has cultivated a distinctive philosophy of representation. Every opportunity secured in Abuja and indeed, the world must be redirected home. This principle has become the defining ethos of his stewardship, the hallmark of his mission to Abuja as the representative of the federal constituency. Ultimately, this is the reason Bende has been made a consistent beneficiary of federal presence. Since his emergence at the thresholds of National Assembly, his imprint has been visible across vital spheres of social and human developments. Roads have been constructed, hospitals established, schools built and rehabilitated, health centres founded and constituents empowered through genuine business grants rather than token gestures. Yet in recent times, commercial and social life had become increasingly constrained by poor digital connectivity. So, when President Bola Ahmed Tinubu approved the National Universal Communications Access Programme, NUCAP, under the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, Kalu promptly positioned Bende for consideration. Graciously, the President obliged him and the Ministry, to its credit, selected Bende, not Lagos or Abuja for the take off of the project. For purposes of recapitulation and accentuation, NUCAP is a deliberate federal initiative to extend reliable mobile and broadband connectivity to communities underserved by commercial networks. It envisages the deployment of approximately 3,700 modern, renewable energy powered telecom towers across rural, riverine and hard to reach areas, with the objective of connecting nearly 20,000,000 Nigerians presently excluded from basic digital services. In select locations, the towers will be complemented by public WiFi and digital learning tools. The programme, understandably complements Project BRIDGE, the 90,000 kilometre fibre optic backbone, and NIGCOMSAT satellite coverage. Its dividends are far reaching. Enhanced market access for farmers and traders, expanded financial inclusion through mobile banking, improved access to emergency, educational and healthcare services, and strengthened communication for democratic processes, including BVAS operations. At the commissioning ceremony in Bende on Friday, performed by the Minister of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, Dr Bosun Tijani on Friday, Kalu spoke to human experience, deliberately avoiding technical distractions. He said: “For those who have always enjoyed reliable network service, connectivity may seem ordinary. For a rural trader whose payment repeatedly fails, a student who cannot join an online lesson, or a family struggling to contact a doctor, it is anything but ordinary. It can determine whether an opportunity is secured or lost. Where a person lives should not determine the limits of what that person can become.” He distilled the intervention into the contemporary, lived realities of his constituents.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/n.title_zh: NUCAP：副议长卡鲁如何为阿比亚州本德带来数字机遇
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/n.body_zh: 多年来，奔德地区的连通性并非理所当然，而是一种追求。为了拨打或接听电话，居民们要穿越一两公里，从一个地点转移到另一个地点寻找信号。机会流失。发展停滞。进步受阻。这感觉像是回到了18世纪的黑暗时代。令人兴奋的是，漫长的等待、担忧和看似失望的局面于2026年10月16日星期五结束，当时沿乌穆阿希亚-奥哈菲亚公路在奔德安装了一座数字电信塔。随着这座独特的桅杆安装完毕，寻求可靠通信的漫长历程终于结束。这一发展是又一项战略干预，是由众议院副议长、本杰明·奥凯齐·卡卢博士、CFR为阿比亚州奔德联邦选区带来并吸引的发展势头。对那些熟悉其政治轨迹的人来说，这并不令人惊讶。卡卢培养了一种独特的代表哲学。在阿布贾乃至全世界获得的每一个机会都必须转回家乡。这一原则已成为其管理工作的定义精神，也是其作为联邦选区代表前往阿布贾的使命标志。最终，这就是奔德一直成为联邦存在受益者的原因。自从他进入国民议会门槛以来，其印记在社会和人类发展的关键领域清晰可见。道路得以修建，医院得以建立，学校得以建造和修复，卫生中心得以创立，选民通过真正的商业赠款而非象征性姿态获得赋权。然而最近，商业和社会生活因数字连通性差而日益受限。因此，当博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统批准联邦通信、创新和数字经济部下的国家普遍通信接入计划（NUCAP）时，卡卢迅速将奔德定位为考虑对象。总统欣然同意了他，而该部也值得称赞地选择了奔德，而不是拉各斯或阿布贾，作为该项目的启动地点。为了回顾和强调，NUCAP是一项有意的联邦举措，旨在将可靠的移动和宽带连通性扩展到商业网络服务不足的社区。它设想部署大约3700座现代化的、由可再生能源供电的电信塔，覆盖农村、沿河和难以到达的地区，目标是连接近20000000名目前被排除在基本数字服务之外的尼日利亚人。在选定地点，这些塔将辅以公共WiFi和数字学习工具。该计划可以理解地补充了BRIDGE项目，即90000公里光纤骨干网，以及NIGCOMSAT卫星覆盖。其红利影响深远。为农民和贸易者增强市场准入，通过移动银行扩大金融包容性，改善获取紧急、教育和医疗服务的途径，并加强民主进程的通信，包括BVAS操作。在奔德于星期五举行的启用仪式上，由通信、创新和数字经济部长博桑·蒂贾尼博士主持，卡卢谈到了人类体验，故意避免技术干扰。他说：“对于那些一直享受可靠网络服务的人来说，连通性可能显得普通。对于一个农村贸易者来说，其付款反复失败，一个学生无法加入在线课程，或者一个家庭努力联系医生，这绝非普通。它可以决定机会是被抓住还是失去。一个人居住的地方不应决定那个人能成为什么的极限。”他将这一干预提炼成其选民当代的、实际的生活现实。

https://dailytrust.com/rainbow-coalition.title: Rainbow coalition stirs more controversies in states
https://dailytrust.com/rainbow-coalition.summary: P olitical calculations in many states have been altered with the recognition of the Rainbow Coalition championed by the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, as a result of his inclusion in the President Bola Ahmed Tinubu/APC 2027 Presidential Campaign Council. In Edo State, the Rainbow Coalition remains active despite the death of its leader, late Chief Dan Orbih, Daily Trust learnt.
https://dailytrust.com/rainbow-coalition.summary_zh: 许多州的的政治算计因联邦首都区 (FCT) 部长 Nyesom Wike 所倡导的彩虹联盟获得认可而发生改变，这是由于他被纳入总统 Bola Ahmed Tinubu/APC 2027 年总统竞选委员会的结果。在埃多州，尽管其领导人已故 Chief Dan Orbih 去世，彩虹联盟仍保持活跃，《每日信托报》获悉。
https://dailytrust.com/rainbow-coalition.body: P olitical calculations in many states have been altered with the recognition of the Rainbow Coalition championed by the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, as a result of his inclusion in the President Bola Ahmed Tinubu/APC 2027 Presidential Campaign Council. Prior to the launch of the campaign council in Abuja last week, All Progressives Congress (APC) governors led by Hope Uzodinma of Imo vehemently rejected the coalition plan, saying they would only work for the candidates of the APC. The coalition, as proposed by the FCT minister, intends to work for the reelection of President Tinubu in 2027 but line up behind candidates of other parties, especially the PDP, for other elective posts. Our correspondents report that in many states, the Wike-backed PDP is fielding strong candidates for the governorship and National Assembly elections whose visibility even threatens the chances of sitting governors and their candidates. The FCT minister has maintained that his support for President Tinubu’s re-election does not oblige him to support every APC governor or candidate. The Wike-led faction of the PDP in Adamawa State has continued its political activities without disruption following the resolution of its internal dispute. Since the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) released the list of governorship candidates submitted by political parties, the dispute over the PDP’s authentic candidate appears to have been resolved. Chief Maurice Michael Vonobolki was recognised, rather than Caleb Andrew, who had claimed to be the party’s candidate on social media. The party’s state secretary, Alhaji Shekarau Yerima, said the Wike factor would not affect the PDP, insisting that it had followed electoral guidelines and its constitution. He described the PDP as a strong contender in the 2027 elections, citing its victories in the 2023 general and recent local government elections in the state. In Kwara State, the coalition has exposed divisions within the ruling APC over Governor AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq’s succession plan, our correspondent reports. At the centre of the realignment are aggrieved APC chieftains, the Otoge Progressives (TOP), members of the G15 group of governorship aspirants and politicians associated with former Senate President Bukola Saraki. Although their interests differ, their opposition to the governor’s preferred succession arrangement could complicate the APC’s electoral plans. The coalition gained visibility on August 26, when Senator Saliu Mustapha unveiled its state chapter in Ilorin. Mustapha, who defected from the APC to the PDP, also declared his intention to challenge AbdulRazaq for the Kwara Central senatorial seat. Wike recently blamed AbdulRazaq for the coalition’s growth, accusing him of ignoring the grievances of the G15. He also warned that the governor would face a major challenge. Speaking on the coalition’s implications for the 2027 elections, PDP Publicity Secretary Olusegun Olushola Adewara said the party had no problem with President Bola Tinubu’s re-election bid, as its primary goal was to unseat AbdulRazaq. Adewara added that the PDP had no objection to APC members joining the coalition, stressing that its focus was on winning elections in the state. In Edo State, the Rainbow Coalition remains active despite the death of its leader, late Chief Dan Orbih, Daily Trust learnt. Orbih spearheaded the coalition during the 2024 governorship election, in which Governor Monday Okpebholo defeated the PDP candidate, Barrister Asue Ighodalo. The coalition is still active in the state and is working towards the re-election of President Bola Tinubu. Speaking with Daily Trust, the PDP secretary in Edo, Hilary Otsu, said Wike’s Rainbow Coalition remained active in the state, as in other parts of the country. Otsu said many people were involved in the coalition in Edo and argued that the arrangement would not affect the chances of PDP candidates in state elections.
https://dailytrust.com/rainbow-coalition.title_zh: 彩虹联盟在各州引发更多争议
https://dailytrust.com/rainbow-coalition.body_zh: 许多州的政坛算计因联邦首都区（FCT）部长奈耶索姆·维克所倡导的彩虹联盟获得认可而发生改变，这是由于他被纳入总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布/APC 2027年总统竞选委员会的结果。在上周阿布贾竞选委员会启动之前，由伊莫州州长霍普·乌佐丁马领导的进步大会党（APC）州长们强烈拒绝该联盟计划，称他们只会为APC的候选人工作。该联盟按FCT部长的提议，打算为蒂努布总统2027年的连任工作，但在其他选举职位上支持其他政党的候选人，尤其是PDP的候选人。我们的记者报道称，在许多州，维克支持的PDP正在为州长和国民议会选举推出强大候选人，其知名度甚至威胁到现任州长及其候选人的机会。FCT部长坚持认为，他对蒂努布总统连任的支持并不迫使他支持每一位APC州长或候选人。阿达马瓦州维克领导的PDP派系在解决其内部纠纷后继续其政治活动不受干扰。自独立国家选举委员会（INEC）公布政党提交的州长候选人名单以来，关于PDP真实候选人的纠纷似乎已得到解决。莫里斯·迈克尔·沃诺博尔基酋长被认可，而不是曾在社交媒体上声称自己是该党候选人的凯莱布·安德鲁。该党州秘书阿尔哈吉·谢卡劳·耶里马表示，维克因素不会影响PDP，坚持认为它遵循了选举指南及其宪法。他将PDP描述为2027年选举的强大竞争者，引用其在2023年大选和该州最近的地方政府选举中的胜利。在夸拉州，该联盟暴露了执政APC内部关于州长阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿卜杜勒拉扎克继任计划的分歧，我们的记者报道。处于重新组合中心的是不满的APC领袖、Otoge Progressives (TOP)、G15州长候选人团体成员以及与前参议院议长布科拉·萨拉基有关的政治人物。尽管他们的利益不同，但他们对州长首选继任安排的反对可能使APC的选举计划复杂化。该联盟于8月26日获得关注，当时参议员萨柳·穆斯塔法在伊洛林揭晓了其州分部。穆斯塔法从APC叛逃到PDP，还宣布了他挑战阿卜杜勒拉扎克争夺夸拉中央参议院席位的意图。维克最近指责阿卜杜勒拉扎克造成了该联盟的增长，指控他忽视G15的不满。他还警告说，该州长将面临重大挑战。在谈到该联盟对2027年选举的影响时，PDP宣传秘书奥卢塞贡·奥卢肖拉·阿德瓦拉表示，该党对博拉·蒂努布总统的连任竞选没有问题，因为其主要目标是罢免阿卜杜勒拉扎克。阿德瓦拉补充说，PDP不反对APC成员加入该联盟，强调其重点是赢得该州的选举。在埃多州，尽管其领导人已故丹·奥尔比赫酋长去世，彩虹联盟仍保持活跃，Daily Trust获悉。奥尔比赫在2024年州长选举期间领导了该联盟，在该选举中州长蒙代·奥克佩博洛击败了PDP候选人巴里斯特·阿苏·伊戈达洛。该联盟在该州仍保持活跃，并致力于博拉·蒂努布总统的连任。在与Daily Trust交谈时，埃多州PDP秘书希拉里·奥楚表示，维克的彩虹联盟在该州保持活跃，就像在该国其他地区一样。奥楚说，许多人参与了埃多州的联盟，并认为该安排不会影响PDP候选人在州选举中的机会。

https://leadership.ng/benue-pdp-challeng.body: The PDP State Publicity Secretary, Bright Yima Antyo, made the demand in a statement, urging Alia to publicly clarify the figures and publish the state’s revenue and expenditure records since he assumed office on May 29, 2023. The opposition party also called on the governor to provide verifiable details of projects funded by the state government, the amounts spent and their completion status. It further demanded explanations of security expenditure and the results achieved, while urging all 23 local government councils in the state to publicly account for their respective allocations. The statement described Wike’s disclosure as a weighty claim that required a clear response from the Benue State Government. “This is a weighty statement from a serving federal minister. Why has the Benue State Government failed to offer a clear public response to Chief Wike’s disclosure? Does the governor dispute the figures? If he does, why has he not come forward with the actual figures? If he agrees with the minister, why has he not considered it necessary to explain to the people what his administration has done with the enormous resources available to Benue State, following the removal of fuel subsidy?” the PDP asked. The party alleged that since taking office on May 29, 2023, Alia had not delivered a comprehensive public accountability briefing covering the revenues received, expenditure incurred, projects executed and results achieved by his administration. The PDP further claimed that its assessment put the combined FAAC allocations to the state government and its 23 local government areas at more than ₦1.3 trillion during the period under review. “Both tiers of government under the firm grip of Governor Alia owe Benue people accountability. “The questions are simple: How much has come in, how much has been spent, and what can the government show for it?” the statement added. However, the All Progressives Congress (APC) in Benue State challenged the PDP to account for the financial record of the administration of former Governor Samuel Ortom before criticising Alia over the state’s revenue and expenditure. The APC State Publicity Secretary, Benedict Yawe, made the counter-demand in a statement, arguing that the opposition party should address questions about its own record in government. “The PDP governed Benue State for more than two decades, including eight years under Ortom. However, its record during that period continues to attract questions about public finance, workers’ welfare, infrastructure and the management of government-owned assets,” the APC stated. The exchange comes amid calls by the opposition for greater transparency in the management of public funds in Benue State, with the PDP demanding a detailed account of revenue and expenditure under Alia and the APC urging its critics to explain the record of the previous administration. https://leadership.ng/kwankwasiyya-quest.summary: The movement also demanded an explanation for the timing of the proposed borrowing, asking the government to demonstrate why the projects could not be funded through existing budgetary provisions and available public revenue. The movement also urged the Kano State House of Assembly to clarify whether it had formally approved or authorised the proposed arrangement and publish the relevant legislative resolution and supporting documents.
https://leadership.ng/kwankwasiyya-quest.summary_zh: 该运动还要求解释拟议借款的时机，要求政府说明为什么这些项目不能通过现有预算拨款和可用公共收入提供资金。该运动还敦促卡诺州议会澄清它是否已正式批准或授权拟议的安排，并公布相关立法决议和支持文件。
https://leadership.ng/kwankwasiyya-quest.body: The movement’s spokesperson, Dr Habibu Sale Mohammed, raised the concerns in a statement issued on Sunday, October 18, 2026, saying each council could be required to take on a financial obligation of about ₦1.3 billion. According to the statement, the funds would reportedly be used to establish Computer-Based Testing (CBT) centres, execute an unspecified project and finance an empowerment programme. While acknowledging the importance of educational infrastructure and economic empowerment, the movement questioned why local governments should incur substantial debts for projects reportedly to be administered by the state government. “Our fundamental question is: Why should the 44 Local Government Councils be compelled to assume substantial debt obligations for projects reportedly to be administered by the State Government?” the statement queried. The movement also demanded an explanation for the timing of the proposed borrowing, asking the government to demonstrate why the projects could not be funded through existing budgetary provisions and available public revenue. It said the approaching electoral cycle made transparency and safeguards necessary to ensure that the funds were used exclusively for approved public projects. The group said the reported breakdown included about ₦632.57 million per council for a CBT centre, ₦500 million for an unspecified project and ₦117.41 million for an empowerment programme. It called for details of the projects, including the locations of the CBT centres, feasibility studies, cost assessments and the criteria for selecting beneficiaries of the empowerment initiative. The movement also demanded an account of funds reportedly contributed or released by local government councils to the state government under a previous joint empowerment programme, particularly the monthly women’s empowerment initiative. It asked the government to disclose the total amount received from the councils, the amount disbursed to beneficiaries, administrative expenses and any remaining balance. The statement further questioned why the programme reportedly operated for fewer than 10 months despite expectations of its continuation. “Before the councils are asked to incur fresh debts for another empowerment programme, the government must account for the previous funds and explain the status of the initiative,” it said. The movement also urged the Kano State House of Assembly to clarify whether it had formally approved or authorised the proposed arrangement and publish the relevant legislative resolution and supporting documents. It appealed to the commercial bank reportedly considering the facility to verify the borrowing authority of each council, the legality of the proposed security arrangements, repayment capacity and the intended use of the funds. The statement said the bank should ensure that the transaction complied with applicable laws and had safeguards against diversion of public funds. Citing the Supreme Court’s July 2024 judgment on local government financial autonomy, the movement called for an independent legal assessment to determine whether the proposed arrangement complied with the Constitution, applicable laws and public borrowing regulations. It warned that local government chairmen should not be reduced to signing financial obligations for projects whose proceeds they do not control, particularly if repayments could undermine their ability to provide essential services. “The people of Kano State deserve to know why their Local Government Councils are being asked to assume substantial debts, who will control the proceeds, what benefits the projects will deliver and how the obligations will be repaid,” the statement said. https://leadership.ng/kwankwasiyya-quest.body_zh: 该运动的发言人哈比布·萨利赫·穆罕默德博士在2026年10月18日星期日发表的一份声明中提出了这些担忧，称每个地方议会可能需要承担约13亿奈拉的财政义务。根据声明，这些资金据称将用于建立计算机化考试（CBT）中心、执行一个未具体说明的项目以及资助一项赋权计划。该运动在承认教育基础设施和经济赋权重要性的同时，质疑为什么地方政府应该为据称由州政府管理的项目承担巨额债务。“我们的根本问题是：为什么44个地方政府议会要被迫承担据称由州政府管理的项目的巨额债务义务？”声明质问道。该运动还要求解释拟议借款的时机，要求政府说明为什么这些项目不能通过现有的预算拨款和可用公共收入来资助。它表示，即将到来的选举周期使得透明度和保障措施成为必要，以确保资金专门用于批准的公共项目。该组织称，据报道的细分包括每个议会约6.3257亿奈拉用于CBT中心、5亿奈拉用于一个未具体说明的项目以及1.1741亿奈拉用于赋权计划。它呼吁提供项目细节，包括CBT中心的位置、可行性研究、成本评估以及选择赋权计划受益人的标准。该运动还要求说明据称由地方政府议会根据先前联合赋权计划向州政府贡献或释放的资金情况，特别是每月妇女赋权倡议。它要求政府披露从议会收到的总金额、支付给受益人的金额、行政费用以及任何剩余余额。声明进一步质疑为什么该计划据称只运行了不到10个月，尽管预期会继续。“在要求议会为另一项赋权计划承担新债务之前，政府必须说明先前资金的去向并解释该倡议的现状，”它说。该运动还敦促卡诺州议会澄清它是否已正式批准或授权拟议的安排，并公布相关立法决议和支持文件。它呼吁据称正在考虑该融资的商业银行核实每个议会的借款权限、拟议担保安排的合法性、偿还能力以及资金的预期用途。声明称，银行应确保交易符合适用法律，并有防止公共资金挪用的保障措施。引用最高法院2024年7月关于地方政府财政自治的判决，该运动呼吁进行独立的法律评估，以确定拟议安排是否符合宪法、适用法律和公共借款规定。它警告称，地方政府主席不应沦为签署他们无法控制收益的项目的财政义务，特别是如果偿还可能削弱他们提供基本服务的能力。“卡诺州人民有权知道为什么他们的地方政府议会要承担巨额债务，谁将控制收益，这些项目将带来什么好处以及这些义务将如何偿还，”声明说。我们拥有优势。获取实时报道、突发独家新闻和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧的新闻。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/district-min.summary: Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah, Minister of Lands and Natural Resources, has announced that District Mining Committee’s will begin to issue mining licenses at the local levels under the new Mining and Minerals Act. Speaking at the launch of Ellembelle Cooperative Mining Societies at Nkroful, Mr Armah-Kofi Buah, who is also the Member of Parliament (MP) for Ellembelle, explained that acquisition of mining licenses would start from the district where the mining company wants to operate.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/district-min.summary_zh: 土地和自然资源部长 Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah 宣布，根据新的《采矿和矿产法》，地区采矿委员会将开始在地方层面颁发采矿许可证。在 Nkroful 举行的 Ellembelle 合作采矿协会启动仪式上，同时担任 Ellembelle 国会议员的 Armah-Kofi Buah 先生解释说，获取采矿许可证将从采矿公司希望运营的地区开始。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/district-min.body: Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah, Minister of Lands and Natural Resources, has announced that District Mining Committee’s will begin to issue mining licenses at the local levels under the new Mining and Minerals Act. Speaking at the launch of Ellembelle Cooperative Mining Societies at Nkroful, Mr Armah-Kofi Buah, who is also the Member of Parliament (MP) for Ellembelle, explained that acquisition of mining licenses would start from the district where the mining company wants to operate. That, he said would end the practice of going through rigorous processes by travelling to Accra in pursuit of mining licenses. The Ellembelle District Mining Cooperative Societies are Nkroful-Atomic, Kikam, Salma, Asanda, Bomoakpole and Nzema-Akropong. The Minister charged the mining cooperatives to be guided by the training to engage in responsible mining without destroying the environment, land and water bodies and cautioned them to operate within their concessions and not trespass to undertake illegal mining activities. Mr Armah-Kofi Buah said responsible cooperative mining was to replace illegal mining popularly called galamsey which has ravaged lands and river bodies in the last decade. He said under the new mining act, mining companies would sign an agreement with host communities dubbed “Community Development Agreement” which would ensure a legal agreement with the communities within the mining lease. Mr Joseph Anyimiah, Deputy CEO of the Minerals Commission, said the Commission would ensure that the cooperatives mined within the regulations of the Mining and Minerals Act. He reminded the cooperatives to set aside a percentage of proceeds accruing from their operations for reclamation and development of the communities. Mr Joseph Armah Agyekum, District Chief Executive (DCE) for Ellembelle, called for unity to protect the land, river bodies and forest reserves amid responsible mining. Nana Kwasi Kutua V, Chief of Nkroful, who chaired the function, commended the Mr Armah-Kofi Buah, Buah for the commitment to restore degraded lands, water bodies and forest reserves
https://www.myjoyonline.com/district-min.title_zh: 地区采矿委员会将在新法律下颁发采矿许可证——土地部长
https://www.myjoyonline.com/district-min.body_zh: 土地和自然资源部长 Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah 宣布，地区采矿委员会将根据新的《采矿和矿产法》开始在地方层面颁发采矿许可证。在 Nkroful 举行的 Ellembelle 合作采矿协会启动仪式上，同时担任 Ellembelle 国会议员的 Armah-Kofi Buah 先生解释说，获取采矿许可证将从采矿公司希望运营的地区开始。他说，这将结束通过长途跋涉前往阿克拉追求采矿许可证的繁琐程序。Ellembelle 地区采矿合作协会包括 Nkroful-Atomic、Kikam、Salma、Asanda、Bomoakpole 和 Nzema-Akropong。部长要求采矿合作协会以培训为指导，从事负责任的采矿，不破坏环境、土地和水体，并警告他们要在自己的特许范围内运营，不要越界从事非法采矿活动。Armah-Kofi Buah 先生表示，负责任的合作采矿旨在取代过去十年中破坏土地和河流的非法采矿，即俗称的 galamsey。他说，根据新的采矿法，采矿公司将与东道社区签署一项名为“社区发展协议”的协议，这将确保与采矿租约范围内的社区达成法律协议。矿产委员会副首席执行官 Joseph Anyimiah 先生表示，委员会将确保合作协会在《采矿和矿产法》的规定范围内进行采矿。他提醒合作协会从其运营所得收益中留出一部分用于社区的复垦和发展。Ellembelle 地区首席行政官 Joseph Armah Agyekum 先生呼吁在负责任采矿的同时团结起来保护土地、河流和森林保护区。主持仪式的 Nkroful 酋长 Nana Kwasi Kutua V 赞扬 Armah-Kofi Buah 先生致力于恢复退化的土地、水体和森林保护区。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-secures.title: Gov’t secures €323m to end water crisis in Tamale, Yendi, Damongo
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-secures.summary: The government has secured a total of €323 million financing package for the Northern Ghana Water and Sanitation Project to address persistent water shortages in Tamale, Yendi and Damongo. The project is expected to benefit nearly 1.5 million people people, providing safe drinking water, improving sanitation, public health, and supporting climate resilience for the beneficiary communities.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-secures.summary_zh: 政府已为北加纳水和卫生项目获得总计 3.23 亿欧元的一揽子融资，以解决塔马利、延迪和达蒙戈持续存在的缺水问题。该项目预计将惠及近 150 万人，提供安全饮用水，改善卫生、公共卫生，并支持受益社区的气候韧性。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-secures.body: The government has secured a total of €323 million financing package for the Northern Ghana Water and Sanitation Project to address persistent water shortages in Tamale, Yendi and Damongo. The project is expected to benefit nearly 1.5 million people people, providing safe drinking water, improving sanitation, public health, and supporting climate resilience for the beneficiary communities. Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Baah Forson announced the package on the margins of the 2026 International Monetary Fund (IMF)/World Band Group (WBG) annual meetings in Bangkok. The development emerged from a high-level meeting with European Investment Bank (EIB) Vice-President Ambroise Fayolle, which focused on finalising the terms for the Northern Ghana Water and Sanitation Project. The financing comprise a €225 million highly concessional facility from the EIB, a €68m grant from the European Commission, and a €30m grant from the Dutch government’s Invest International initiative. “I have just concluded a productive meeting with European Investment Bank Vice-President Ambroise Fayolle on the financing package for the Northern Ghana Water and Sanitation Project,” he said. The Finance Minister expressed optimism that the project would address the recurring water shortages and improve sanitation across the three communities in the two Northern regions and the Savannah region. Information provided by the European Investment Bank indicates that the project would improve access to safely managed drinking water services for approximately 1.349m people in the Greater Tamale area. The Bank noted that some 105,000 people in Damongo, covering urban and peri-urban populations were to also benefit from the project. Prior to the project financing conclusion, a baseline water quality assessment exercise was conducted in January 2026 to establish the existing condition of the White Volta River passing through Yapei to its natural source for use. It was observed that the White Volta River exhibited typical freshwater physicochemical characteristics, with neutral pH values ranging from 7.34 to 7.63, low conductivity, and low total dissolved solids, all within applicable national and WHO guideline limits. However, key physical parameters such as turbidity (28.7–30.3 NTU), apparent colour (60–65 Hz), and total suspended solids (28–30 mg/L) exceeded the GS 175:2017 drinking water guideline values at all sampling locations (upstream, intake, and downstream). The baseline study approved the White Volta River as a sustainable source for the project, urging conventional treatment. This includes coagulation, flocculation, sedimentation, filtration, iron removal and disinfection to ensure safe drinking water
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-secures.title_zh: 政府获得3.23亿欧元以结束塔马利、延迪、达蒙戈的用水危机
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-secures.body_zh: 政府已为北加纳供水和卫生项目获得总计3.23亿欧元的融资方案，以解决塔马利、延迪和达蒙戈持续存在的缺水问题。该项目预计将惠及近150万人，提供安全饮用水，改善卫生条件、公共卫生，并支持受益社区的气候韧性。财政部长卡西尔·阿托·巴赫·福森博士在2026年国际货币基金组织（IMF）/世界银行集团（WBG）年度会议在曼谷举行的间隙宣布了这一方案。这一进展源于与欧洲投资银行（EIB）副行长安布罗伊斯·法约勒的高层会议，会议重点是敲定北加纳供水和卫生项目的条款。该融资包括来自欧洲投资银行的2.25亿欧元高度优惠贷款、来自欧盟委员会的6800万欧元赠款，以及来自荷兰政府Invest International倡议的3000万欧元赠款。他说：“我刚刚与欧洲投资银行副行长安布罗伊斯·法约勒就北加纳供水和卫生项目的融资方案结束了一次富有成效的会议。”财政部长表示乐观，认为该项目将解决两个北部地区和萨凡纳地区三个社区反复出现的缺水问题并改善卫生条件。欧洲投资银行提供的信息表明，该项目将改善大塔马利地区约134.9万人获得安全管理饮用水服务的机会。该银行指出，达蒙戈的约10.5万人，包括城市和城郊人口，也将从该项目中受益。在项目融资完成之前，2026年1月进行了一次基线水质评估，以确定流经亚佩伊的白沃尔特河至其自然源头的现有状况以供使用。观察到白沃尔特河表现出典型的淡水理化特征，pH值呈中性，范围为7.34至7.63，电导率低，总溶解固体低，均在适用的国家和世卫组织指南限值内。然而，关键物理参数如浊度（28.7–30.3 NTU）、表观颜色（60–65 Hz）和总悬浮固体（28–30 mg/L）在所有采样点（上游、取水口和下游）均超过了GS 175:2017饮用水指南值。基线研究批准白沃尔特河作为该项目的可持续水源，敦促进行常规处理。这包括混凝、絮凝、沉淀、过滤、除铁和消毒，以确保安全饮用水。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/telecel-grou.summary: Telecel Group, a pan-African telecommunications and technology group, today announced a $200 million strategic partnership with Huawei, formalised through a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) signed at HUAWEI CONNECT 2026 in Shanghai. Eleanor Azar, Chief of Staff of Telecel Group, and Chad Wei, Deputy Managing Director of Huawei Ghana, signed the MOU.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/telecel-grou.summary_zh: Telecel Group是一家泛非电信和科技集团，今天宣布与华为建立2亿美元的战略合作伙伴关系，该合作通过在上海举行的HUAWEI CONNECT 2026上签署的谅解备忘录（MOU）正式确立。Telecel Group首席幕僚Eleanor Azar和华为加纳副总经理Chad Wei签署了该MOU。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/telecel-grou.body: Telecel Group, a pan-African telecommunications and technology group, today announced a $200 million strategic partnership with Huawei, formalised through a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) signed at HUAWEI CONNECT 2026 in Shanghai. Eleanor Azar, Chief of Staff of Telecel Group, and Chad Wei, Deputy Managing Director of Huawei Ghana, signed the MOU. Nicolas Bourg, Chairman of Telecel Group, and Rex Lei, Regional Vice President of Huawei, witnessed the signing. The three-year agreement nearly triples the $70 million framework signed by the two companies in Shenzhen last November and further strengthens the long-standing strategic relationship between Telecel Group and Huawei. Under the framework, the companies will collaborate on Telecel Group’s network expansion, mobile broadband densification and intelligent digital infrastructure across its operations. Ghana will be a key focus of the investment program, supporting Telecel’s continued network expansion and growing consumer and enterprise customer base in the market. The partnership will be implemented through a phased, three-year roadmap, supporting faster, more reliable connectivity, an enhanced customer experience, and infrastructure capable of supporting future technologies across Telecel’s markets. “This partnership reflects our long-term commitment to investing in world-class telecommunications infrastructure across Africa,” said Nicolas Bourg, Chairman of Telecel Group. “ Expanding our partnership with Huawei from a $70 million framework to a $200 million, three-year program is an important step in our growth strategy. Ghana remains a cornerstone of our operations and an important part of this investment roadmap.” “Huawei is proud to deepen its strategic partnership with Telecel Group at a time of continued growth and investment across Africa,” said Rex Lei, Regional Vice President of Huawei. “This agreement reflects our shared commitment to advancing digital infrastructure and connectivity. Huawei will bring its technology, expertise and deployment capabilities to support Telecel Group’s three-year roadmap and continued expansion.” The agreement reinforces Telecel Group’s commitment to long-term investment in its markets and to advancing digital inclusion and economic development through reliable, future-ready connectivity
https://www.myjoyonline.com/telecel-grou.title_zh: Telecel集团与华为签署2亿美元战略合作伙伴关系
https://www.myjoyonline.com/telecel-grou.body_zh: Telecel Group 是一家泛非电信和科技集团，今天宣布与华为建立 2 亿美元的战略合作伙伴关系，该合作通过在上海举行的 HUAWEI CONNECT 2026 大会上签署的谅解备忘录（MOU）正式确立。Telecel Group 首席幕僚 Eleanor Azar 和华为加纳副总经理 Chad Wei 签署了该 MOU。Telecel Group 董事长 Nicolas Bourg 和华为区域副总裁 Rex Lei 见证了签约仪式。这份为期三年的协议几乎是两家公司去年 11 月在深圳签署的 7000 万美元框架协议的三倍，进一步巩固了 Telecel Group 与华为之间长期的战略关系。根据该框架，双方将在 Telecel Group 的网络扩展、移动宽带密集化和智能数字基础设施方面开展合作，覆盖其所有运营区域。加纳将是该投资计划的重点，支持 Telecel 在该市场的持续网络扩展以及不断增长的消费者和企业客户群。该合作伙伴关系将通过一个分阶段的三年路线图实施，支持更快、更可靠的连接、提升客户体验，并构建能够支持 Telecel 各市场未来技术的基础设施。“这一合作伙伴关系体现了我们对在非洲投资世界级电信基础设施的长期承诺，”Telecel Group 董事长 Nicolas Bourg 表示。“将我们与华为的合作伙伴关系从 7000 万美元框架扩大到 2 亿美元的三年计划，是我们增长战略的重要一步。加纳仍然是我们运营的基石，也是这一投资路线图的重要组成部分。”“华为很自豪能在非洲持续增长和投资之际深化与 Telecel Group 的战略合作伙伴关系，”华为区域副总裁 Rex Lei 表示。“这份协议反映了我们共同致力于推进数字基础设施和连接的承诺。华为将带来其技术、专业知识和部署能力，以支持 Telecel Group 的三年路线图和持续扩张。”该协议强化了 Telecel Group 对其市场进行长期投资的承诺，并通过可靠、面向未来的连接来推进数字包容和经济发展

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/p.body: Makinde stands by his claim, says presidency’s response side stepped central issue .Wants breakdown of how the $3bn NLNG revenue gotten under Tinubu’s govt was shared The Presidency and Governor Seyi Makinde of Oyo State on Sunday disagree over the reported withholding of NLNG dividends of N250 billion due to each state by the federal government. While the Presidency punctured the claim by Oyo governor as being false and should be disregarded, Makinde in another response saud he stood by his claims while asking for a breakdown of how $3 billion that accrued under the Tinubu’s government were shared among the three tiers of government. The Presidency had submitted that report that the federal government was withholding N250 billion dividends accruing to each of the 36 states from the Nigerian Liquified and Natural Gas (NLNG) was false and should be disregarded forthwith. Makinde had on Friday at the 2027 Budget Stakeholders’ Consultative Engagement held at the Olola Ogunlana Hall, International Conference Centre, University of Ibadan claimed the funds would not be released until after the 2027 elections adding that the Federal Government had spent the money. “Each state was supposed to get ₦250 billion. We had already identified projects that would expand Oyo State’s economy. But they have now said the money will not be paid until after the election. Is the election more important than the people of Nigeria?” the governor said. Reacting to the claim, The Presidency in a release issued by presidential spokesperson, Bayo Onanuga stated that Makinde’s latest claim that the Federal Government is withholding the NLNG dividend windfall is false and should be disregarded. He explained how the Federation Account is managed and how money is shared among the three tiers of government. According to him: “Even as a one-off distribution, ₦250 billion to each of the 36 states amounts to ₦9.0 trillion, excluding the Federal Government, the FCT, and the 774 local councils. “Under the Federation Account Allocation Committee (FAAC) formula, states receive 26.72% of the distributable Federation Account revenue. For the states’ share alone to reach ₦9 trillion, total NLNG dividends paid into the Federation Account would have to exceed ₦33.68 trillion (about $25 billion) in a single declaration.” The Presidency added that NLNG has never paid $25 billion in dividends to the Federation Account in a single payout. It further delved into NLNG and its Historical Dividend Context saying NLNG has paid approximately $21.5 billion in dividends to the Federation over the last 25 years, with less than $3 billion realised since President Bola Tinubu assumed office. The Presidency also posited that any claim that a single payout exceeds the company’s entire lifetime distribution to the Federation—and is being withheld—defies basic logic and economic reality. “We expect Governor Makinde to be more measured in his public conduct and utterances. Since he embarked on his presidential bid, he has chosen to play politics by making misleading claims rather than presenting verifiable facts. Indeed, he has turned false, unguarded statements and claims into an art form. “He once described the huge financial flow from the federation account to states, including Oyo, as ‘voodoo’. “Under Nigerian law, Governor Makinde is free to pursue his presidential ambition. He should desist from making falsehoods and disinformation the hallmarks of his campaign. “We urge the public to disregard these unfounded claims, which serve only to mislead citizens and stoke needless disaffection against the Federal authorities,” the Presidency further said. In a swift reaction on Sunday, Governor Makinde said he stood by his submission saying Presidency’s response side stepped the central issue at hand.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/p.title_zh: 总统府与奥约州州长就扣留每个州应得的2500亿奈拉NLNG红利指控发生争执
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/p.body_zh: 马金德坚持自己的说法，称总统府的回应回避了核心问题。要求说明在蒂努布政府下获得的30亿美元NLNG收入如何分配。周日，总统府与奥约州州长塞伊·马金德就联邦政府据称扣留每个州2500亿奈拉NLNG股息的报道产生分歧。总统府驳斥奥约州州长的说法是虚假的，应予无视，而马金德在另一份回应中表示他坚持自己的说法，同时要求说明在蒂努布政府下获得的30亿美元如何在三级政府之间分配。总统府曾表示，联邦政府扣留来自尼日利亚液化天然气公司（NLNG）的每个36个州的2500亿奈拉股息的报道是虚假的，应立即予以无视。马金德周五在伊巴丹大学国际会议中心奥洛拉·奥贡拉纳厅举行的2027年预算利益相关者咨询会议上声称，这些资金要到2027年选举后才会发放，并补充说联邦政府已经花掉了这笔钱。“每个州应该得到2500亿奈拉。我们已经确定了能够扩大奥约州经济的项目。但他们现在说这笔钱要到选举后才会支付。选举比尼日利亚人民更重要吗？”州长说。在回应这一说法时，总统府通过总统发言人巴约·奥纳努加发表的声明表示，马金德最近关于联邦政府扣留NLNG股息意外之财的说法是虚假的，应予无视。他解释了联邦账户如何管理以及如何在三级政府之间分配资金。他说：“即使作为一次性分配，给36个州每个州2500亿奈拉，总额也将达到9.0万亿奈拉，不包括联邦政府、联邦首都区和774个地方议会。根据联邦账户分配委员会（FAAC）公式，各州获得可分配联邦账户收入的26.72%。仅各州的份额就要达到9万亿奈拉，总NLNG股息支付到联邦账户的金额就必须超过33.68万亿奈拉（约250亿美元）在单次申报中。”总统府补充说，NLNG从未在单次支付中向联邦账户支付250亿美元股息。它进一步深入探讨NLNG及其历史股息背景，称NLNG在过去25年中向联邦支付了约215亿美元的股息，自博拉·蒂努布总统上任以来实现的不到30亿美元。总统府还指出，任何声称单次支付超过该公司向联邦的整个生命周期分配——并且正在被扣留——的说法都违背基本逻辑和经济现实。“我们期望马金德州长在其公开行为和言论中更加谨慎。自从他开始总统竞选以来，他选择通过发表误导性说法而不是提供可验证的事实来玩弄政治。事实上，他已经把虚假、无拘束的声明和说法变成了一种艺术形式。”“他曾经将来自联邦账户向包括奥约州在内的各州的大量资金流动描述为‘巫术’。”“根据尼日利亚法律，马金德州长有权追求他的总统抱负。他应该停止将虚假和虚假信息作为其竞选的标志。”“我们敦促公众无视这些毫无根据的说法，这些说法只会误导公民并煽动对联邦当局的不必要不满，”总统府进一步表示。周日，马金德州长迅速回应说，他坚持自己的说法，称总统府的回应回避了当前的核心问题。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/a.body: But the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council (ADC-PCC) has dismissed Kwankwaso’s response to its earlier statement as diversionary, insisting that his reaction has further raised questions about his political alignment with the All Progressives Congress (APC) and President Bola Tinubu. The ADC-PCC had earlier advised Kwankwaso to stop attacking the ADC presidential candidate, Alhaji Atiku Abubakar, and redirect his energy towards holding the ruling APC accountable for its failures. The Council maintained that, as an opposition figure, Kwankwaso should be challenging the Tinubu administration over the worsening economic hardship, insecurity and declining living standards confronting Nigerians, rather than repeatedly targeting Atiku and the ADC. In a statement, yesterday, the Director of Media and Publicity of the ADC-PCC, Kola Ologbondiyan, said Kwankwaso’s response had failed to address the substance of the Council’s concerns. According to the ADC-PCC, Kwankwaso casually mentioned the APC in his defence but devoted much of his response to attacking the ADC, a development it said raised questions about his priorities as an opposition leader. “Why is Senator Kwankwaso making our candidate the issue instead of confronting the ruling APC, whose policies have made life increasingly difficult for millions of Nigerians?” the Council asked. It argued that Nigerians were more concerned about hunger, insecurity, high fuel prices, the depreciation of the naira and the crushing economic hardship under the APC-led government than political exchanges among opposition figures. The Council insisted that these national challenges should be the priority of any politician genuinely committed to providing an alternative to the Tinubu administration. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/a.body: The major overhaul of Nigeria’s tax system by the federal government has started to yield fruits as just 20 firms listed on the Nigerian Exchange Limited (NGX) paid a whooping N3.04 trillion as income tax to Nigeria Revenue Service (NRS) and other agencies in first half ended June 30, 2026. This represents an increase of 79.5 per cent from N1.69 trillion remitted in first half of 2025. The firms cut across banking sector, cement manufacturing, Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), telecommunication, among other sectors in Nigeria economy. The standard corporate income tax rate remains 30 per cent, but the reforms by NRS introduced a 4 per cent development levy on assessable profits for companies within scope. This levy replaced several separate federal levies, so the net impact depends on what each company paid previously. Nigeria’s tax reforms, particularly the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 and related legislation that took effect on January 1, 2026, have important implications for companies listed on the NGX. They affect corporate tax costs, cash flow, dividend capacity, investment decisions, compliance expenses and, potentially, share-price performance. But expert believe the impact will not be the same for every company. “It will depend on profitability, sector, tax incentives, capital expenditure, financing structure and how effectively each company adapts to the new rules,” said a tax expert. Meanwhile, analysis of the financial results of the 20 firms showed that Seplat Energy Plc, followed by Aradel Holdings paid the highest tax to revenue agencies in the period under review. Seplat Energy in the H1 2026 declared N564.94 billion tax expenses, a 37.2 per cent increase over N411.59 billion reported in H1 2025, while Aradel Holdings announced N561.7 billion tax expenses in H1 2026, up by 1150.4 per cent from N44.92billion in H1 2025. Seplat in a statement said, “In accordance with IAS 34: Interim Financial Reporting, income tax expense for the interim period has been determined using the estimated weighted average annual effective income tax rate expected for the full financial year. This estimate is reviewed at each interim reporting date and adjusted, where necessary, to reflect changes in the expected annual tax rate. “Income tax expense for the group is analysed by Oil segment – Half year ended N533.7 billion (H1 2025: N353.5 billion); 3 months ended N372.9 billion (H1 2025: N97.5 billion) and Gas Segment – Half year ended N31.2 billion (H1 2025: N58.1 billion); 3 months ended N15.4 billion (H1 2025: N34.8 billion). The company said it has applied the provisions of the Nigeria Tax Act 2025, which became effective in January 2026 and require Education Tax, the NASENI levy, and the Police Trust Fund Levy to be consolidated into Development Levy. In the period under review, MTN Nigeria Communications Plc declared N384.05billion tax income, which is 85 per cent increase over N207.41 billion in H1 2025. Dangote Cement announced N342.85 billion income tax expense in H1 2026, a growth of 63.6 per cent from N209.6billion reported in H1 2025. Of the N3.04 trillion income tax expense, a total of nine banks remitted N845.79 billion in H1 2026, about 42 per cent increase over N596.79 billion in H1 2025. Zenith Bank led eight others with the highest tax income in the period, announcing N206.84 billion, about 121.34 per cent increase over N93.45billion in the corresponding period of 2025. Following the 121.34 per cent increase in tax income, Zenith Bank saw its profit dropped by 19.06 per cent to N430.76 billion in H1 2026. Analysts expressed the importance of companies remitting taxes to government agencies, stressing that listing on the NGX gives room for companies to be transparent in tax payment to government agencies. Commenting, Vice-President, Highcap Securities Limited, Mr. David Adnori stated that listed companies may be paying more taxes this year, stressing on its importance on shareholders’ return.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/a.title_zh: 在税收改革中，20家蓝筹公司向NRS及其他机构汇出N3.04trn
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/a.body_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府对税收体系的重大改革已开始产生成果，在截至2026年6月30日的上半年，只有20家在尼日利亚交易所有限公司（NGX）上市的公司向尼日利亚税务局（NRS）和其他机构缴纳了高达3.04万亿奈拉的所得税。这比2025年上半年汇缴的1.69万亿奈拉增长了79.5%。这些公司涵盖银行业、水泥制造、快速消费品（FMCG）、电信以及尼日利亚经济的其他部门。标准公司所得税税率仍为30%，但NRS的改革对范围内的公司按应税利润引入了4%的发展税。该税取代了若干单独的联邦税费，因此净影响取决于每家公司此前缴纳的金额。尼日利亚的税收改革，特别是2025年尼日利亚税收法及相关立法于2026年1月1日生效，对在NGX上市的公司具有重要影响。它们影响公司税负、现金流、派息能力、投资决策、合规费用，并可能影响股价表现。但专家认为，对每家公司的影响不会相同。“这将取决于盈利能力、行业、税收激励、资本支出、融资结构以及每家公司适应新规则的效率，”一位税务专家表示。与此同时，对这20家公司财务结果的分析显示，Seplat Energy Plc其次是Aradel Holdings在审查期间向税务机构缴纳了最高税款。Seplat Energy在2026年上半年申报了5649.4亿奈拉的税费支出，比2025年上半年报告的4115.9亿奈拉增长37.2%，而Aradel Holdings在2026年上半年宣布了5617亿奈拉的税费支出，比2025年上半年的449.2亿奈拉增长1150.4%。Seplat在一份声明中表示，“根据IAS 34：中期财务报告，中期所得税费用已使用预计适用于整个财政年度的加权平均年度有效所得税税率确定。该估计在每个中期报告日进行审查，并在必要时进行调整，以反映预期年度税率的变化。“集团的所得税费用按石油板块分析——半年结束为5337亿奈拉（2025年上半年：3535亿奈拉）；3个月结束为3729亿奈拉（2025年上半年：975亿奈拉）和天然气板块——半年结束为312亿奈拉（2025年上半年：581亿奈拉）；3个月结束为154亿奈拉（2025年上半年：348亿奈拉）。该公司表示，它已适用2025年尼日利亚税收法的规定，该法于2026年1月生效，要求将教育税、NASENI税和警察信托基金税合并为发展税。在审查期间，MTN Nigeria Communications Plc申报了3840.5亿奈拉的所得税收入，比2025年上半年的2074.1亿奈拉增长85%。Dangote Cement在2026年上半年宣布了3428.5亿奈拉的所得税费用，比2025年上半年报告的2096亿奈拉增长63.6%。在3.04万亿奈拉的所得税费用中，共有九家银行在2026年上半年汇缴了8457.9亿奈拉，较2025年上半年的5967.9亿奈拉增长约42%。Zenith Bank在该期间领先其他八家，宣布了2068.4亿奈拉的最高所得税收入，较2025年同期934.5亿奈拉增长约121.34%。在所得税收入增长121.34%之后，Zenith Bank的利润在2026年上半年下降19.06%至4307.6亿奈拉。分析师强调了公司向政府机构缴纳税款的重要性，强调在NGX上市使公司能够透明地向政府机构缴纳税款。在评论中，Highcap Securities Limited副总裁David Adnori先生表示，上市公司今年可能缴纳更多税款，并强调这对股东回报的重要性。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/t.title: Towards Building Healthy Economy
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/t.summary: The objectives of the economic reforms by the federal government and the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) are primarily to correct the anomalies, and towards building a healthy and sustainable economy going forward, though the policy implementations may be disruptive and distressful for a period in the timeline, but as it is said, “no pain, no gain”.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/t.summary_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府和尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）经济改革的目标主要是纠正异常现象，并朝着建设一个健康和可持续的经济迈进，尽管政策实施可能会在一段时间内具有破坏性和带来压力，但正如人们所说，“没有付出，就没有收获”。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/t.body: The objectives of the economic reforms by the federal government and the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) are primarily to correct the anomalies, and towards building a healthy and sustainable economy going forward, though the policy implementations may be disruptive and distressful for a period in the timeline, but as it is said, “no pain, no gain”. Economy is the focal point and lifeblood of the people and which is why responsible governments and all relevant institutions would do all necessary things to ensure a healthy and sustainable economy. Because of the inevitable disruptive effects of the economic reforms, President Tinubu has thus far introduced some social safety nets to help cushion the impact of the reforms towards building a healthy economy in the long run. Basically, a healthy economy features a robust financial system, low inflation, stable prices, low unemployment/ high employment (so that those who want jobs can easily find one), and wages that match or beat inflation. Other features are moderate interest rate to channel capital to productive sectors, stable exchange rate to enable businesses plan with certainty, high consumer confidence, balanced imports and exports and growth in GDP. CBN has thus far implemented some notable policies that have positively impacted some of the above-listed economic variables as part of the reforms towards building a healthy economy. The apex bank keyed into the envisioned US$1trillion economy envisioned by President Tinubu and has implemented a proactive and seamless banks recapitalisation policy to ensure a robust financial system. It is expected that the recapitalised banks will channel credits into productive sectors especially agriculture, manufacturing, infrastructure, technology and small and medium enterprises to justify the essence of their recapitalisation. After the recapitalisation, CBN Governor, Olayemi Cardoso noted that the apex bank had shifted focus to ensuring that stronger capital translated into support for productive activities. CBN has also stabilized the exchange rate and fought inflation aggressively and reduced it from it previous high levels to 15.39% and is still targeting to moderate it further. With the reforms, Nigeria’s economy presently can be likened to a sick patient that was taken to the intensive care unit of a hospital and underwent two major life-saving surgeries for stabilization and subsequent healing and expected restoration of good health. The unified exchange rate has its pros and cons but CBN’s target goals for adopting the new regime are to remove the ambiguities of the previous exchange rate regime and ensure transparency, true price discovery through “willing buyer, willing seller” mechanism, curb rent-seeking and to attract foreign direct investments (FDIs). The unified exchange rate has contributed in stabilizing the economy. The fuel subsidy removal was an inevitable, bold and courageous policy action because fuel subsidy constituted a huge financial burden and drained government resources which often led to large deficits. It also led to fuel smuggling and scarcity and corruption. The removal of fuel subsidy was a financial lifeline for the economy. It generated about N 15.8 trillion to the economy between June 2023 and December 2025. World bank noted that between 2020 and 2021, inflation left about eight million more Nigerians below the poverty line and increased the number of poor people to about 90 million. To minimize poverty and actualize the objective and drive of the present economic reform towards building a healthy economy, the present macroeconomic stability should be maintained and inflation should be further moderated through a combination of the monetarist policy by CBN and the boosting of the supply side of the economy.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/t.title_zh: 朝着建设健康经济迈进
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/t.body_zh: 联邦政府和尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）的经济改革目标主要是纠正异常现象，并朝着建设一个健康和可持续的经济体迈进，尽管政策实施可能会在一段时间内具有破坏性和带来痛苦，但正如俗语所说，“不劳无获”。经济是人民的焦点和命脉，这就是为什么负责任的政府和所有相关机构会尽一切必要努力来确保一个健康和可持续的经济。由于经济改革的不可避免的破坏性影响，总统蒂努布迄今引入了一些社会安全网，以帮助缓冲改革的影响，朝着长期建设健康经济迈进。基本上，健康的经济具有以下特征：强大的金融体系、低通胀、稳定的价格、低失业率/高就业率（这样那些想要工作的人可以轻松找到一份工作），以及与通胀相匹配或超过通胀的工资。其他特征包括适度的利率以将资本引导到生产部门、稳定的汇率以使企业能够确定地进行规划、高消费者信心、平衡的进出口以及GDP增长。CBN迄今实施了一些显著的政策，这些政策积极影响了上述部分经济变量，作为朝着建设健康经济进行改革的一部分。央行加入了总统蒂努布设想的1万亿美元经济愿景，并实施了积极且无缝的银行资本重组政策，以确保强大的金融体系。预计资本重组后的银行将把信贷引导到生产部门，特别是农业、制造业、基础设施、技术以及中小企业，以证明其资本重组的本质。在资本重组之后，CBN行长奥拉耶米·卡多索指出，央行已将重点转移到确保更强的资本转化为对生产活动的支持。CBN还稳定了汇率，并积极对抗通胀，将其从之前的高水平降低到15.39%，并且仍在目标进一步适度降低它。通过改革，尼日利亚经济目前可以比作一个被带到医院重症监护室的病人，接受了两次重大的挽救生命的 surgery 以实现稳定以及随后的愈合和预期恢复良好健康。统一的汇率有其利弊，但CBN采用新制度的目標目标是消除先前汇率制度的模糊性，并确保透明度，通过“愿意买方、愿意卖方”机制实现真实的价格发现，遏制寻租并吸引外国直接投资（FDIs）。统一的汇率有助于稳定经济。取消燃料补贴是一项不可避免的、大胆且勇敢的政策行动，因为燃料补贴构成了巨大的财政负担并耗尽了政府资源，这往往导致巨额赤字。它还导致燃料走私、短缺和腐败。取消燃料补贴是经济的金融生命线。它在2023年6月至2025年12月期间为经济带来了约15.8万亿奈拉。世界银行指出，在2020年至2021年期间，通胀使另外约800万尼日利亚人陷入贫困线以下，并将贫困人口数量增加到约9000万。为了最小化贫困并实现当前经济改革朝着建设健康经济的目标和动力，目前的宏观经济稳定应得到维持，并应通过CBN的货币主义政策与经济供给侧的提振相结合，进一步适度降低通胀。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/i.summary_zh: 在最近完成资本重组流程后，保险公司正急切等待其托管账户中的3000亿奈拉资金释放，因为尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）开始进行尽职调查。最近，国家保险委员会（NAICOM）表示，它已正式指示央行释放资金。在拉各斯向新闻界发表讲话时，尼日利亚保险商协会（NIA）主席Ebelechukwu Nwachukwu夫人透露，NAICOM已指示CBN释放资金。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/i.body: Following the recent conclusion of recapitalisation process, insurers are eagerly awaiting the release of N300 billion in their escrow account as the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) commences due diligence. Recently, the National Insurance Commission (NAICOM), said it has formally instructed the apex bank to release the funds. The Commissioner for Insurance, Mr Olusegun Ayo Omosehin had at a press briefing in Lagos told the media that insurers would by the end of September receive their funds. Addressing newsmen in Lagos, the Chairman, Nigerian Insurers Association (NIA), Mrs. Ebelechukwu Nwachukwu, disclosed that NAICOM has instructed CBN to release the funds. She however assured operators that the funds were expected to be fully returned within this month of October. “NAICOM has done its part by issuing instructions to the CBN. The funds will be returned to the exact accounts from which they were sent once the CBN completes its verification,” she stated. She urged insurance operators that crossed the recapitalisation hurdle to deploy the enhanced capital base to expand local underwriting capacity, increase retention during reinsurance renewals, and provide cover for emerging exposures such as cyber and climate risks. She said having successfully concluded the recapitalisation exercise the regulator has come up with implementation of the Risk Base Capital model. She said the regulator has appointed global professional services firm Ernst & Young (EY) as its consultant to guide the Nigerian insurance industry through a transparent and structured transition to a Risk-Based Capital (RBC) regime. According to her, the Commissioner for Insurance, Olusegun Omosehin, announced the appointment during the insurers’ committee meeting alongside other crucial regulatory directives shaping the post-recapitalisation era.
